verses.sa:
ब्रह्म जज्ञानं प्रथमं पुरस्ताद्वि सीमतः सुरुचो वेन आवः ।
स बुध्न्या उपमा अस्य विष्ठाः सतश्च योनिमसतश्च वि वः ॥
verses.rom:
brahma jajnanam prathamam purastadvi simatah surucho vena avah |
sa budhnya upama asya vishthah satashcha yonimasatashcha vi vah ||
verses.en: The bráhman that was first born of old (purástāt; in the east?) Vena hath unclosed from the well-shining edge (sīmatás; horizon?); he unclosed the fundamental nearest shapes (viṣṭhā́) of it, the womb (yóni) of the existent and of the non-existent.

verses.sa:
इयं पित्र्या राष्ट्र्येत्वग्रे प्रथमाय जनुषे भुवनेष्ठाः ।
तस्मा एतं सुरुचं ह्वारमह्यं घर्मं श्रीणन्तु प्रथमाय धास्यवे ॥
verses.rom:
iyam pitrya rashtryetvagre prathamaya janushe bhuvaneshthah |
tasma etam surucham hvaramahyam gharmam shrinantu prathamaya dhasyave ||
verses.en: Let this queen of the Fathers (? pítrya) go in the beginning (ágre) for the first birth (janús; race?), standing in the creation; for it (him?) have I sent (hi) this well-shining sinuous one (? hvārá); let them mix (çrī; boil?) the hot drink for the first thirsty one (? dhāsyú).

verses.sa:
प्र यो जज्ञे विद्वान् अस्य बन्धुर्विश्वा देवानां जनिमा विवक्ति ।
ब्रह्म ब्रह्मण उज्जभार मध्यान् नीचैरुच्चैः स्वधा अभि प्र तस्थौ ॥
verses.rom:
pra yo jajne vidvan asya bandhurvishva devanam janima vivakti |
brahma brahmana ujjabhara madhyan nichairuchchaih svadha abhi pra tasthau ||
verses.en: He who was born forth the knowing relative of it speaks all the births (jániman) of the gods; he bore up the bráhman from the midst of the bráhman; downward, upward, he set forth unto the svadhā́s.

verses.sa:
स हि विदः स पृथिव्या ऋतस्था मही क्षेमं रोदसी अस्कभायत्।
महान् मही अस्कभायद्वि जातो द्यां सद्म पार्थिवं च रजः ॥
verses.rom:
sa hi vidah sa prithivya ritastha mahi kshemam rodasi askabhayat|
mahan mahi askabhayadvi jato dyam sadma parthivam cha rajah ||
verses.en: For he of the heaven, he of the earth the right-stander, fixed (skabh) [as his] abode (kṣéma) the (two) great firmaments (ródasī) the great one, when born, fixed apart the (two) great ones, the heaven [as] seat (sádman) and the earthly space (rájas).

verses.sa:
स बुध्न्यादाष्ट्र जनुषोऽभ्यग्रं बृहस्पतिर्देवता तस्य सम्राट्।
अहर्यच्छुक्रं ज्योतिषो जनिष्टाथ द्युमन्तो वि वसन्तु विप्राः ॥
verses.rom:
sa budhnyadashtra janusho'bhyagram brihaspatirdevata tasya samrat|
aharyachchhukram jyotisho janishtatha dyumanto vi vasantu viprah ||
verses.en: He from the fundamental birth (janús) hath attained (aç) unto (abhi) the summit; Brihaspati, the universal ruler, [is] the divinity of him; since the bright (çukrá) day was born of light, then let the shining (dyumánt) seers (vípra) fade out (? vi-vas) shine out?.

verses.sa:
नूनं तदस्य काव्यो हिनोति महो देवस्य पूर्व्यस्य धाम ।
एष जज्ञे बहुभिः साकमित्था पूर्वे अर्धे विषिते ससन् नु ॥
verses.rom:
nunam tadasya kavyo hinoti maho devasya purvyasya dhama |
esha jajne bahubhih sakamittha purve ardhe vishite sasan nu ||
verses.en: Verily doth the kāvyá further (hi) that of him—the abode (? dhā́man) of the great god of old (pūrvyá); he was born together with many thus, sleeping now in the loosened (vi-si) eastern half.

verses.sa:
योऽथर्वाणं पितरं देवबन्धुं बृहस्पतिं नमसाव च गछात्।
त्वं विश्वेषां जनिता यथासः कविर्देवो न दभायत्स्वधावान् ॥
verses.rom:
yo'tharvanam pitaram devabandhum brihaspatim namasava cha gachhat|
tvam vishvesham janita yathasah kavirdevo na dabhayatsvadhavan ||
verses.en: Whoso shall approach (? ava-gam) with homage father Atharvan, relative of the gods, Brihaspati—in order that thou mayest be generator of all, poet, god, not to be harmed, self-ruling (? svadhā́vant).

verses.sa:
य आत्मदा बलदा यस्य विश्व उपासते प्रशिषं यस्य देवाः ।
योऽस्येशे द्विपदो यश्चतुष्पदः कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम ॥
verses.rom:
ya atmada balada yasya vishva upasate prashisham yasya devah |
yo'syeshe dvipado yashchatushpadah kasmai devaya havisha vidhema ||
verses.en: He who is soul-giving, strength-giving; of whom all, of whom [even] the gods, wait upon the instruction; who is lord (īç) of these bipeds, who of quadrupeds—to what god may we pay worship (vidh) with oblation?

verses.sa:
यः प्राणतो निमिषतो महित्वैको राजा जगतो बभूव ।
यस्य छायामृतं यस्य मृत्युः कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम ॥
verses.rom:
yah pranato nimishato mahitvaiko raja jagato babhuva |
yasya chhayamritam yasya mrityuh kasmai devaya havisha vidhema ||
verses.en: He who by his greatness became sole king of the breathing, winking animal creation (jágat); of whom immortality (amṛ́tam), of whom death [is] the shadow—to what god may we pay worship with oblation?

verses.sa:
यं क्रन्दसी अवतश्चस्कभाने भियसाने रोदसी अह्वयेथाम् ।
यस्यासौ पन्था रजसो विमानः कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम ॥
verses.rom:
yam krandasi avatashchaskabhane bhiyasane rodasi ahvayetham |
yasyasau pantha rajaso vimanah kasmai devaya havisha vidhema ||
verses.en: He whom the (two) spheres (krándasī) favor when fixed; whom the terrified firmaments (rodasī) called upon; whose is yon road, traverser of the welkin (rájas)—to what god may we pay worship with oblation?

verses.sa:
यस्य द्यौरुर्वी पृथिवी च मही यस्याद उर्वन्तरिक्षम् ।
यस्यासौ सूरो विततो महित्वा कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम ॥
verses.rom:
yasya dyaururvi prithivi cha mahi yasyada urvantariksham |
yasyasau suro vitato mahitva kasmai devaya havisha vidhema ||
verses.en: [By the greatness] of whom the wide heaven and the great earth, [by the greatness] of whom yon wide atmosphere, by the greatness of whom yon sun [is] extended—to what god may we pay worship with oblation?

verses.sa:
यस्य विश्वे हिमवन्तो महित्वा समुद्रे यस्य रसामिदाहुः ।
इमाश्च प्रदिशो यस्य बाहू कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम ॥
verses.rom:
yasya vishve himavanto mahitva samudre yasya rasamidahuh |
imashcha pradisho yasya bahu kasmai devaya havisha vidhema ||
verses.en: Whose [are] all the snowy mountains by [his] greatness; whose, verily, they call Rasā in the ocean; and of whom these directions are the (two) arms—to what god may we pay worship with oblation?

verses.sa:
आपो अग्रे विश्वमावन् गर्भं दधाना अमृता ऋतज्ञाः ।
यासु देवीष्वधि देव आसीत्कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम ॥
verses.rom:
apo agre vishvamavan garbham dadhana amrita ritajnah |
yasu devishvadhi deva asitkasmai devaya havisha vidhema ||
verses.en: The waters in the beginning favored (av) the all, assuming an embryo, they the immortal, order-knowing ones, over whom, divine ones, the god was—to what god may we pay worship with oblation?

verses.sa:
हिरण्यगर्भः समवर्तताग्रे भूतस्य जातः पतिरेक आसीत्।
स दाधार पृथिवीमुत द्यां कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम ॥
verses.rom:
hiranyagarbhah samavartatagre bhutasya jatah patireka asit|
sa dadhara prithivimuta dyam kasmai devaya havisha vidhema ||
verses.en: The golden embryo was evolved (sam-vṛt) in the beginning; it was, when born, the sole lord of existence (bhūtá); it maintained earth and heaven—to what god may we pay worship with oblation?

verses.sa:
आपो वत्सं जनयन्तीर्गर्भमग्रे समैरयन् ।
तस्योत जायमानस्योल्ब आसीद्धिरण्ययः कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम ॥
verses.rom:
apo vatsam janayantirgarbhamagre samairayan |
tasyota jayamanasyolba asiddhiranyayah kasmai devaya havisha vidhema ||
verses.en: The waters, generating a young (vatsá), set in motion (sam-īray) in the beginning an embryo; and of that, when born, the fœtal envelop (úlba) was of gold—to what god may we pay worship with oblation?

verses.sa:
उदितस्त्रयो अक्रमन् व्याघ्रः पुरुषो वृकः ।
हिरुग्घि यन्ति सिन्धवो हिरुग्देवो वनस्पतिर्हिरुङ्नमन्तु शत्रवः ॥
verses.rom:
uditastrayo akraman vyaghrah purusho vrikah |
hirugghi yanti sindhavo hirugdevo vanaspatirhirunnamantu shatravah ||
verses.en: Up from here have stridden three—tiger, man (púruṣa), wolf; since hey! go the rivers, hey! the divine forest-tree, hey! let the foes bow.

verses.sa:
परेणैतु पथा वृकः परमेणोत तस्करः ।
परेण दत्वती रज्जुः परेणाघायुरर्षतु ॥
verses.rom:
parenaitu patha vrikah paramenota taskarah |
parena datvati rajjuh parenaghayurarshatu ||
verses.en: By a distant (pára) road let the wolf go, by a most distant also the thief; by a distant one the toothed rope, by a distant one let the malignant hasten (ṛṣ).

verses.sa:
अक्ष्यौ च ते मुखं च ते व्याघ्र जम्भयामसि ।
आत्सर्वान् विंशतिं नखान् ॥
verses.rom:
akshyau cha te mukham cha te vyaghra jambhayamasi |
atsarvan vimshatim nakhan ||
verses.en: Both thy (two) eyes and thy mouth, O tiger, we grind up; then all thy twenty claws (nakhá).

verses.sa:
व्याघ्रं दत्वतां वयं प्रथमं जम्भयामसि ।
आदु ष्टेनमथो अहिं यातुधानमथो वृकम् ॥
verses.rom:
vyaghram datvatam vayam prathamam jambhayamasi |
adu shtenamatho ahim yatudhanamatho vrikam ||
verses.en: The tiger first of [creatures] with teeth do we grind up, upon that also the thief, then the snake, the sorcerer, then the wolf.

verses.sa:
यो अद्य स्तेन आयति स संपिष्टो अपायति ।
पथामपध्वंसेनैत्विन्द्रो वज्रेण हन्तु तम् ॥
verses.rom:
yo adya stena ayati sa sampishto apayati |
pathamapadhvamsenaitvindro vajrena hantu tam ||
verses.en: What thief shall come today, he shall go away smashed; let him

verses.sa:
मूर्णा मृगस्य दन्ता अपिशीर्णा उ पृष्टयः ।
निम्रुक्ते गोधा भवतु नीचायच्छशयुर्मृगः ॥
verses.rom:
murna mrigasya danta apishirna u prishtayah |
nimrukte godha bhavatu nichayachchhashayurmrigah ||
verses.en: Ruined (mūrṇá) [are] the teeth of the beast (mṛgá); crushed in also [are its] ribs; disappearing be for thee the godhā́; downward go (ayat) the lurking (? çaçayú) beast.

verses.sa:
यत्संयमो न वि यमो वि यमो यन् न संयमः ।
इन्द्रजाः सोमजा आथर्वणमसि व्याघ्रजम्भनम् ॥
verses.rom:
yatsamyamo na vi yamo vi yamo yan na samyamah |
indrajah somaja atharvanamasi vyaghrajambhanam ||
verses.en: What thou contractest (sam-yam) mayest thou not protract (vi-yam); mayest thou protract what thou dost not contract; Indra-born, soma-born art thou, an Atharvan tiger-crusher (-jámbhana).

verses.sa:
यां त्वा गन्धर्वो अखनद्वरुणाय मृतभ्रजे ।
तां त्वा वयं खनामस्योषधिं शेपहर्षणीम् ॥
verses.rom:
yam tva gandharvo akhanadvarunaya mritabhraje |
tam tva vayam khanamasyoshadhim shepaharshanim ||
verses.en: Thee that the Gandharva dug for Varuṇa whose virility (? -bhráj) was dead, thee here do we dig, a penis-erecting herb.

verses.sa:
उदुषा उदु सूर्य उदिदं मामकं वचः ।
उदेजतु प्रजापतिर्वृषा शुष्मेण वाजिना ॥
verses.rom:
udusha udu surya udidam mamakam vachah |
udejatu prajapatirvrisha shushmena vajina ||
verses.en: Up, the dawn; up, too, the sun; up, these words (vácas) of mine; up be Prajāpati stirring, the bull, with vigorous (vājín) energy (çúṣma).

verses.sa:
यथा स्म ते विरोहतोऽभितप्तमिवानति ।
ततस्ते शुष्मवत्तरमियं कृणोत्वोषधिः ॥
verses.rom:
yatha sma te virohato'bhitaptamivanati |
tataste shushmavattaramiyam krinotvoshadhih ||
verses.en: As forsooth of thee growing up (? vi-ruh) it breathes as if heated (? abhi-tap)—more full of energy than that let this herb make for thee.

verses.sa:
उच्छुष्मौषधीनां सारा ऋषभाणाम् ।
सं पुंसामिन्द्र वृष्ण्यमस्मिन् धेहि तनूवशिन् ॥
verses.rom:
uchchhushmaushadhinam sara rishabhanam |
sam pumsamindra vrishnyamasmin dhehi tanuvashin ||
verses.en: Up, the energies (çúṣma) of herbs, the essences (sā́ra) of bulls; the virility (vṛ́ṣṇya) of men (púṁs) do thou put together in him, O Indra, self-controller.

verses.sa:
अपां रसः प्रथमजोऽथो वनस्पतीनाम् ।
उत सोमस्य भ्रातास्युतार्शमसि वृष्ण्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
apam rasah prathamajo'tho vanaspatinam |
uta somasya bhratasyutarshamasi vrishnyam ||
verses.en: Of the waters the first-born sap, likewise of the forest-trees; also Soma's brother art thou; also virility art thou of the stag.

verses.sa:
अद्याग्ने अद्य सवितरद्य देवि सरस्वति ।
अद्यास्य ब्रह्मणस्पते धनुरिवा तानया पसः ॥
verses.rom:
adyagne adya savitaradya devi sarasvati |
adyasya brahmanaspate dhanuriva tanaya pasah ||
verses.en: Now, Agni! now, Savitar! now, goddess Sarasvatī! now, Brahmaṇaspati, make his member taut like a bow.

verses.sa:
आहं तनोमि ते पसो अधि ज्यामिव धन्वनि ।
क्रमस्वर्श इव रोहितमनवग्लायता सदा ॥
verses.rom:
aham tanomi te paso adhi jyamiva dhanvani |
kramasvarsha iva rohitamanavaglayata sada ||
verses.en: I make thy member taut, like a bowstring on a bow; mount (kram), as it were a stag a doe, unrelaxingly always (?).

verses.sa:
अश्वस्याश्वतरस्याजस्य पेत्वस्य च ।
अथ ऋषभस्य ये वाजास्तान् अस्मिन् धेहि तनूवशिन् ॥
verses.rom:
ashvasyashvatarasyajasya petvasya cha |
atha rishabhasya ye vajastan asmin dhehi tanuvashin ||
verses.en: Of the horse, of the mule, of the he-goat and of the ram, also of the bull what vigors there are—them do thou put in him, O self-controller.

verses.sa:
सहस्रशृङ्गो वृषभो यः समुद्रादुदाचरत्।
तेना सहस्येना वयं नि जनान्त्स्वापयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
sahasrashringo vrishabho yah samudradudacharat|
tena sahasyena vayam ni janantsvapayamasi ||
verses.en: The thousand-horned bull that came up from the ocean—with him, the powerful one, do we put the people to sleep.

verses.sa:
न भूमिं वातो अति वाति नाति पश्यति कश्चन ।
स्त्रियश्च सर्वाः स्वापय शुनश्चेन्द्रसखा चरन् ॥
verses.rom:
na bhumim vato ati vati nati pashyati kashchana |
striyashcha sarvah svapaya shunashchendrasakha charan ||
verses.en: The wind bloweth not over the earth; no one soever seeth over [it]; both all the women and the dogs do thou make to sleep, going with Indra as companion.

verses.sa:
प्रोष्ठेशयास्तल्पेशया नारीर्या वह्यशीवरीः ।
स्त्रियो याः पुण्यगन्धयस्ताः सर्वाः स्वापयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
proshtheshayastalpeshaya narirya vahyashivarih |
striyo yah punyagandhayastah sarvah svapayamasi ||
verses.en: The women that are lying on a bench, lying on a couch, lying in a litter; the women that are of pure odor—all of them we make to sleep.

verses.sa:
एजदेजदजग्रभं चक्षुः प्राणमजग्रभम् ।
अङ्गान्यजग्रभं सर्वा रात्रीणामतिशर्वरे ॥
verses.rom:
ejadejadajagrabham chakshuh pranamajagrabham |
anganyajagrabham sarva ratrinamatisharvare ||
verses.en: Whatever stirs have I seized; eye, breath have I seized; all the limbs have I seized, in the depth (atiçarvará) of the nights.

verses.sa:
य आस्ते यश्चरति यश्च तिष्ठन् विपश्यति ।
तेषां सं दध्मो अक्षीणि यथेदं हर्म्यं तथा ॥
verses.rom:
ya aste yashcharati yashcha tishthan vipashyati |
tesham sam dadhmo akshini yathedam harmyam tatha ||
verses.en: Whoso sits, whoso goes about, and whoso standing looks out—of them we put together the eyes, just like this habitation (harmyá).

verses.sa:
स्वप्तु माता स्वप्तु पिता स्वप्तु श्वा स्वप्तु विश्पतिः ।
स्वपन्त्वस्यै ज्ञातयः स्वप्त्वयमभितो जनः ॥
verses.rom:
svaptu mata svaptu pita svaptu shva svaptu vishpatih |
svapantvasyai jnatayah svaptvayamabhito janah ||
verses.en: Let the mother sleep, the father sleep, the dog sleep, the housemaster (viçpáti) sleep; let the relatives (jñātí) of her sleep; let this folk round about sleep.

verses.sa:
स्वप्न स्वप्नाभिकरणेन सर्वं नि स्वापया जनम् ।
ओत्सूर्यमन्यान्त्स्वापयाव्युषं जागृतादहमिन्द्र इवारिष्टो अक्षितः ॥
verses.rom:
svapna svapnabhikaranena sarvam ni svapaya janam |
otsuryamanyantsvapayavyusham jagritadahamindra ivarishto akshitah ||
verses.en: O sleep, with the imposition (abhikaraṇa) of sleep do thou put to. sleep all the folk; till sun-up make the others sleep, till dawning let me be awake, like Indra, uninjured, unexhausted.

verses.sa:
ब्राह्मणो जज्ञे प्रथमो दशशीर्षो दशास्यः ।
स सोमं प्रथमः पपौ स चकारारसं विषम् ॥
verses.rom:
brahmano jajne prathamo dashashirsho dashasyah |
sa somam prathamah papau sa chakararasam visham ||
verses.en: The Brahman was born first, with ten heads, with ten mouths; he first drank the soma; he made the poison sapless.

verses.sa:
यावती द्यावापृथिवी वरिम्णा यावत्सप्त सिन्धवो वितष्ठिरे ।
वाचं विषस्य दूषणीं तामितो निरवादिषम् ॥
verses.rom:
yavati dyavaprithivi varimna yavatsapta sindhavo vitashthire |
vacham vishasya dushanim tamito niravadisham ||
verses.en: As great as [are] heaven-and-earth by their width, as much as the seven rivers spread out (vi-sthā), [so far] have I spoken out from here these words (vā́c), spoilers of poison.

verses.sa:
सुपर्णस्त्वा गरुत्मान् विष प्रथममावयत्।
नामीमदो नारूरुप उतास्मा अभवः पितुः ॥
verses.rom:
suparnastva garutman visha prathamamavayat|
namimado narurupa utasma abhavah pituh ||
verses.en: The winged (garutmant) eagle consumed (av) thee first, O poison; thou hast not intoxicated (mad), thou hast not racked (rup) [him]; and thou becamest drink for him.

verses.sa:
यस्त आस्यत्पञ्चाङ्गुरिर्वक्राच्चिदधि धन्वनः ।
अपस्कम्भस्य शल्यान् निरवोचमहं विषम् ॥
verses.rom:
yasta asyatpanchangurirvakrachchidadhi dhanvanah |
apaskambhasya shalyan niravochamaham visham ||
verses.en: He of five fingers that hurled at thee from some crooked bow—from the tip (çalyá) of the apaskambhá have I exorcised (nir-vac) the poison.

verses.sa:
शल्याद्विषं निरवोचं प्राञ्जनादुत पर्णधेः ।
अपाष्ठाच्छृङ्गात्कुल्मलान् निरवोचमहं विषम् ॥
verses.rom:
shalyadvisham niravocham pranjanaduta parnadheh |
apashthachchhringatkulmalan niravochamaham visham ||
verses.en: From the tip have I exorcised the poison, from the anointing and from the feather-socket; from the barb (apāṣṭhá), the horn, the neck have I exorcised the poison.

verses.sa:
अरसस्त इषो शल्योऽथो ते अरसं विषम् ।
उतारसस्य वृक्षस्य धनुष्टे अरसारसम् ॥
verses.rom:
arasasta isho shalyo'tho te arasam visham |
utarasasya vrikshasya dhanushte arasarasam ||
verses.en: Sapless, O arrow, is thy tip; likewise thy poison is sapless; also thy bow, of a sapless tree, O sapless one, is sapless.

verses.sa:
ये अपीषन् ये अदिहन् य आस्यन् ये अवासृजन् ।
सर्वे ते वध्रयः कृता वध्रिर्विषगिरिः कृतः ॥
verses.rom:
ye apishan ye adihan ya asyan ye avasrijan |
sarve te vadhrayah krita vadhrirvishagirih kritah ||
verses.en: They who mashed, who smeared, who hurled, who let loose—they [are] all made impotent; impotent is made the poison-mountain.

verses.sa:
वध्रयस्ते खनितारो वध्रिस्त्वमस्योषधे ।
वध्रिः स पर्वतो गिरिर्यतो जातमिदं विषम् ॥
verses.rom:
vadhrayaste khanitaro vadhristvamasyoshadhe |
vadhrih sa parvato giriryato jatamidam visham ||
verses.en: Impotent [are] thy diggers; impotent art thou, O herb; impotent [is] that rugged (párvata) mountain whence was born this poison.

verses.sa:
वारिदं वारयातै वरणावत्यामधि ।
तत्रामृतस्यासिक्तं तेना ते वारये विषम् ॥
verses.rom:
varidam varayatai varanavatyamadhi |
tatramritasyasiktam tena te varaye visham ||
verses.en: This water (vā́r) shall ward off (vāray-) upon the Varaṇāvatī; an on-pouring of ambrosia (amṛ́ta) is there; with it I ward off thy poison.

verses.sa:
अरसं प्राच्यं विषमरसं यदुदीच्यम् ।
अथेदमधराच्यं करम्भेण वि कल्पते ॥
verses.rom:
arasam prachyam vishamarasam yadudichyam |
athedamadharachyam karambhena vi kalpate ||
verses.en: Sapless is the poison of the east, sapless what is of the north; also this that is of the south is exchangeable with gruel (karambhá).

verses.sa:
करम्भं कृत्वा तिर्यं पीबस्पाकमुदारथिम् ।
क्षुधा किल त्वा दुष्टनो जक्षिवान्त्स न रूरुपः ॥
verses.rom:
karambham kritva tiryam pibaspakamudarathim |
kshudha kila tva dushtano jakshivantsa na rurupah ||
verses.en: Having made gruel of sesame (?), teeming with fat, steaming (?), thou dost not rack, O ill-bodied one, him that has eaten thee merely from hunger.

verses.sa:
वि ते मदं मदावति शरमिव पातयामसि ।
प्र त्वा चरुमिव येषन्तं वचसा स्थापयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
vi te madam madavati sharamiva patayamasi |
pra tva charumiva yeshantam vachasa sthapayamasi ||
verses.en: Away we make thine intoxication fly, like an arrow (çará), O intoxicating one (f.); we make thee with our spell (vácas) to stand forth, like a boiling pot.

verses.sa:
परि ग्राममिवाचितं वचसा स्थापयामसि ।
तिष्ठा वृक्ष इव स्थाम्न्यभ्रिखाते न रूरुपः ॥
verses.rom:
pari gramamivachitam vachasa sthapayamasi |
tishtha vriksha iva sthamnyabhrikhate na rurupah ||
verses.en: With a spell we cause to stand about [thee] as it were a collected troop (grā́ma); stand thou, like a tree in [its] station; spade-dug one (f.), thou rackest not.

verses.sa:
पवस्तैस्त्वा पर्यक्रीणन् दूर्शेभिरजिनैरुत ।
प्रक्रीरसि त्वमोषधेऽभ्रिखाते न रूरुपः ॥
verses.rom:
pavastaistva paryakrinan durshebhirajinairuta |
prakrirasi tvamoshadhe'bhrikhate na rurupah ||
verses.en: For covers (? pavásta) they bought thee, also for garments (? dūrçá), for goat-skins; purchasable (? prakrī́) art thou, O herb; spade-dug one, thou rackest not.

verses.sa:
अनाप्ता ये वः प्रथमा यानि कर्माणि चक्रिरे ।
वीरान् नो अत्र मा दभन् तद्व एतत्पुरो दधे ॥
verses.rom:
anapta ye vah prathama yani karmani chakrire |
viran no atra ma dabhan tadva etatpuro dadhe ||
verses.en: Who of you did what first unattained deeds—let them not harm our heroes here; for that purpose I put you forward.

verses.sa:
भूतो भूतेषु पय आ दधाति स भूतानामधिपतिर्बभूव ।
तस्य मृत्युश्चरति राजसूयं स राजा अनु मन्यतामिदम् ॥
verses.rom:
bhuto bhuteshu paya a dadhati sa bhutanamadhipatirbabhuva |
tasya mrityushcharati rajasuyam sa raja anu manyatamidam ||
verses.en: The being (bhūtá) sets milk in beings; he has become the overlord of beings; Death attends (car) the royal consecration (rājasū́ya) of him; let him, as king, approve this royalty.

verses.sa:
अभि प्रेहि माप वेन उग्रश्चेत्ता सपत्नहा ।
आ तिष्ठ मित्रवर्धन तुभ्यं देवा अधि ब्रुवन् ॥
verses.rom:
abhi prehi mapa vena ugrashchetta sapatnaha |
a tishtha mitravardhana tubhyam deva adhi bruvan ||
verses.en: Go forward unto [it]; do not long (? ven) away, a stern (ugrá) corrector (cettár), rival-slayer; approach (ā-sthā), O increaser of friends; may the gods bless (adhi-brū) thee.

verses.sa:
आतिष्ठन्तं परि विश्वे अभूषं छ्रियं वसानश्चरति स्वरोचिः ।
महत्तद्वृष्णो असुरस्य नामा विश्वरूपो अमृतानि तस्थौ ॥
verses.rom:
atishthantam pari vishve abhusham chhriyam vasanashcharati svarochih |
mahattadvrishno asurasya nama vishvarupo amritani tasthau ||
verses.en: Him approaching all waited upon (pari-bhūṣ); clothing himself in fortune, he goes about (car), having own brightness; great is that name of the virile (vṛ́ṣan) Asura; having all forms, he approached immortal things.

verses.sa:
व्याघ्रो अधि वैयाघ्रे वि क्रमस्व दिशो महीः ।
विशस्त्वा सर्वा वाञ्छन्त्वापो दिव्याः पयस्वतीः ॥
verses.rom:
vyaghro adhi vaiyaghre vi kramasva disho mahih |
vishastva sarva vanchhantvapo divyah payasvatih ||
verses.en: A tiger, upon the tiger's [skin], do thou stride out unto the great quarters; let all the people (víças) want thee, the waters of heaven, rich in milk.

verses.sa:
या आपो दिव्याः पयसा मदन्त्यन्तरिक्ष उत वा पृथिव्याम् ।
तासां त्वा सर्वासामपामभि षिञ्चामि वर्चसा ॥
verses.rom:
ya apo divyah payasa madantyantariksha uta va prithivyam |
tasam tva sarvasamapamabhi shinchami varchasa ||
verses.en: The waters of heaven that revel with milk, in the atmosphere or also on the earth—with the splendor of all those waters do I pour upon (abhi-sic) thee.

verses.sa:
अभि त्वा वर्चसासिचन्न् आपो दिव्याः पयस्वतीः ।
यथासो मित्रवर्धनस्तथा त्वा सविता करत् ॥
verses.rom:
abhi tva varchasasichann apo divyah payasvatih |
yathaso mitravardhanastatha tva savita karat ||
verses.en: The heavenly waters, rich in milk, have poured upon thee with splendor; that thou be an increaser of friends, so shall Savitar make thee.

verses.sa:
एना व्याघ्रं परिषस्वजानाः सिंहं हिन्वन्ति महते सौभगाय ।
समुद्रं न सुभुवस्तस्थिवांसं मर्मृज्यन्ते द्वीपिनमप्स्वन्तः ॥
verses.rom:
ena vyaghram parishasvajanah simham hinvanti mahate saubhagaya |
samudram na subhuvastasthivamsam marmrijyante dvipinamapsvantah ||
verses.en: Thus, embracing the tiger, they incite (hi) the lion unto great good-fortune; as the well-being ones (subhū́) the ocean that stands, do they rub thoroughly down the leopard amid the waters.

verses.sa:
एहि जीवं त्रायमाणं पर्वतस्यास्यक्ष्यम् ।
विश्वेभिर्देवैर्दत्तं परिधिर्जीवनाय कम् ॥
verses.rom:
ehi jivam trayamanam parvatasyasyakshyam |
vishvebhirdevairdattam paridhirjivanaya kam ||
verses.en: Come thou, rescuing the living one; of the mountain art thou for the eyes (?), given by all the gods, an enclosure (paridhí) in order to living.

verses.sa:
परिपाणं पुरुषाणां परिपाणं गवामसि ।
अश्वानामर्वतां परिपाणाय तस्थिषे ॥
verses.rom:
paripanam purushanam paripanam gavamasi |
ashvanamarvatam paripanaya tasthishe ||
verses.en: Protection (paripā́ṇa) of men (púruṣa), protection of kine art thou; in order to the protection of coursing (árvant) horses hast thou stood.

verses.sa:
उतासि परिपाणं यातुजम्भनमाञ्जन ।
उतामृतस्य त्वं वेत्थाथो असि जीवभोजनमथो हरितभेषजम् ॥
verses.rom:
utasi paripanam yatujambhanamanjana |
utamritasya tvam vetthatho asi jivabhojanamatho haritabheshajam ||
verses.en: Both art thou a protection, grinder-up of familiar demons (yātú), O ointment, and of what is immortal thou knowest; likewise art thou gratification (-bhójana) of the living, likewise remedy of jaundice (hárita-).

verses.sa:
यस्याञ्जन प्रसर्पस्यङ्गमङ्गं परुष्परुः ।
ततो यक्ष्मं वि बाधस उग्रो मध्यमशीरिव ॥
verses.rom:
yasyanjana prasarpasyangamangam parushparuh |
tato yakshmam vi badhasa ugro madhyamashiriva ||
verses.en: Of whomsoever, O ointment, thou creepest over limb after limb, joint after joint, from thence thou drivest away the yákṣma, like a formidable mid-lier (madhyamaçī́).

verses.sa:
नैनं प्राप्नोति शपथो न कृत्या नाभिशोचनम् ।
नैनं विष्कन्धमश्नुते यस्त्वा बिभर्त्याञ्जन ॥
verses.rom:
nainam prapnoti shapatho na kritya nabhishochanam |
nainam vishkandhamashnute yastva bibhartyanjana ||
verses.en: Curse attains him not, nor witchcraft, nor scorching; víṣkandha reaches him not who beareth thee, O ointment.

verses.sa:
असन्मन्त्राद्दुष्वप्न्याद्दुष्कृताच्छमलादुत ।
दुर्हार्दश्चक्षुषो घोरात्तस्मान् नः पाह्याञ्जन ॥
verses.rom:
asanmantraddushvapnyaddushkritachchhamaladuta |
durhardashchakshusho ghorattasman nah pahyanjana ||
verses.en: From wrong spell, from evil dreaming, from evil deed, from pollution also, from the terrible eye of an enemy—therefrom protect us, ointment.

verses.sa:
इदं विद्वान् आञ्जन सत्यं वक्ष्यामि नानृतम् ।
सनेयमश्वं गामहमात्मानं तव पूरुष ॥
verses.rom:
idam vidvan anjana satyam vakshyami nanritam |
saneyamashvam gamahamatmanam tava purusha ||
verses.en: Knowing this, O ointment, I shall speak truth, not falsehood; may I win (san) a horse, a cow, thy soul, O man (púruṣa).

verses.sa:
त्रयो दासा आञ्जनस्य तक्मा बलास आदहिः ।
वर्षिष्ठः पर्वतानां त्रिककुन् नाम ते पिता ॥
verses.rom:
trayo dasa anjanasya takma balasa adahih |
varshishthah parvatanam trikakun nama te pita ||
verses.en: Three are the slaves (dāsá) of the ointment—fever (takmán), balā́sa, then snake: the highest of mountains, three-peaked (trikakúd) by name, [is] thy father.

verses.sa:
यदाञ्जनं त्रैककुदं जातं हिमवतस्परि ।
यातूंश्च सर्वाञ्जम्भयत्सर्वाश्च यातुधान्यः ॥
verses.rom:
yadanjanam traikakudam jatam himavataspari |
yatumshcha sarvanjambhayatsarvashcha yatudhanyah ||
verses.en: The ointment that is of the three-peaked [mountain], born from the snowy one (himávant)—may it grind up all the familiar demons and all the sorceresses.

verses.sa:
यदि वासि त्रैककुदं यदि यामुनमुच्यसे ।
उभे ते भद्रे नाम्नी ताभ्यां नः पाह्याञ्जन ॥
verses.rom:
yadi vasi traikakudam yadi yamunamuchyase |
ubhe te bhadre namni tabhyam nah pahyanjana ||
verses.en: If thou art of the three-peaked [mountain], or if thou art called of the Yamunā—both thy names are excellent; by them protect us, O ointment.

verses.sa:
वाताज्जातो अन्तरिक्षाद्विद्युतो ज्योतिषस्परि ।
स नो हिरण्यजाः शङ्खः कृशनः पात्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
vatajjato antarikshadvidyuto jyotishaspari |
sa no hiranyajah shankhah krishanah patvamhasah ||
verses.en: Born from the wind out of the atmosphere, out from the light of lightning, let this gold-born shell, of pearl, protect us from distress.

verses.sa:
यो अग्रतो रोचनानां समुद्रादधि जज्ञिषे ।
शङ्खेन हत्वा रक्षांस्यत्त्रिणो वि षहामहे ॥
verses.rom:
yo agrato rochananam samudradadhi jajnishe |
shankhena hatva rakshamsyattrino vi shahamahe ||
verses.en: Thou that wast born from the top of the shining spaces (rocaná),

verses.sa:
शङ्खेनामीवाममतिं शङ्खेनोत सदान्वाः ।
शङ्खो नो विश्वभेषजः कृशनः पात्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
shankhenamivamamatim shankhenota sadanvah |
shankho no vishvabheshajah krishanah patvamhasah ||
verses.en: By the shell [we overpower] disease, misery; by the shell also the sadā́nvās; let the all-healing shell, of pearl, protect us from distress.

verses.sa:
दिवि जातः समुद्रजः सिन्धुतस्पर्याभृतः ।
स नो हिरण्यजाः शङ्ख आयुष्प्रतरणो मणिः ॥
verses.rom:
divi jatah samudrajah sindhutasparyabhritah |
sa no hiranyajah shankha ayushpratarano manih ||
verses.en: Born in the sky, ocean-born, brought hither out of the river, this gold-born shell [is] for us a life-prolonging amulet.

verses.sa:
समुद्राज्जातो मणिर्वृत्राज्जातो दिवाकरः ।
सो अस्मान्त्सर्वतः पातु हेत्या देवासुरेभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
samudrajjato manirvritrajjato divakarah |
so asmantsarvatah patu hetya devasurebhyah ||
verses.en: The amulet born from the ocean, born from Vṛtra, making day—let it protect us on all sides from the missile of gods and Asuras.

verses.sa:
हिरण्यानामेकोऽसि सोमात्त्वमधि जज्ञिषे ।
रथे त्वमसि दर्शत इषुधौ रोचनस्त्वं प्र ण आयूंषि तारिषत् ॥
verses.rom:
hiranyanameko'si somattvamadhi jajnishe |
rathe tvamasi darshata ishudhau rochanastvam pra na ayumshi tarishat ||
verses.en: One of the golds art thou; out of soma wast thou born; thou art conspicuous on the chariot, lustrous (rocaná) on the quiver thou. May it prolong our lives!

verses.sa:
देवानामस्थि कृशनं बभूव तदात्मन्वच्चरत्यप्स्वन्तः ।
तत्ते बध्नाम्यायुषे वर्चसे बलाय दीर्घायुत्वाय शतशारदाय कार्शनस्त्वाभि रक्षतु ॥
verses.rom:
devanamasthi krishanam babhuva tadatmanvachcharatyapsvantah |
tatte badhnamyayushe varchase balaya dirghayutvaya shatasharadaya karshanastvabhi rakshatu ||
verses.en: The gods' bone became pearl; that goes about within the waters, possessing soul; that do I bind on thee in order to life-time, splendor, strength, to length of life for a hundred autumns: let [the amulet] of pearl defend thee.

verses.sa:
अनड्वान् दाधार पृथिवीमुत द्यामनड्वान् दाधारोर्वन्तरिक्षम् ।
अनड्वान् दाधार प्रदिशः षडुर्वीरनड्वान् विश्वं भुवनमा विवेश ॥
verses.rom:
anadvan dadhara prithivimuta dyamanadvan dadharorvantariksham |
anadvan dadhara pradishah shadurviranadvan vishvam bhuvanama vivesha ||
verses.en: The draft-ox sustains earth and sky; the draft-ox sustains the wide atmosphere; the draft-ox sustains the six wide directions; the draft-ox hath entered into all existence.

verses.sa:
अनड्वान् इन्द्रः स पशुभ्यो वि चष्टे त्रयां छक्रो वि मिमीते अध्वनः ।
भूतं भविष्यद्भुवना दुहानः सर्वा देवानां चरति व्रतानि ॥
verses.rom:
anadvan indrah sa pashubhyo vi chashte trayam chhakro vi mimite adhvanah |
bhutam bhavishyadbhuvana duhanah sarva devanam charati vratani ||
verses.en: The draft-ox [is] Indra; he looks out from (for?) the cattle; triple ways the mighty one (çakrá) measures out (traverses?); yielding (duh) the past (? bhūtá), the future, existing things (bhúvana), he goes upon (car) all the courses (vratá) of the gods.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो जातो मनुष्येष्वन्तर्घर्मस्तप्तश्चरति शोशुचानः ।
सुप्रजाः सन्त्स उदारे न सर्षद्यो नाश्नीयादनडुहो विजानन् ॥
verses.rom:
indro jato manushyeshvantargharmastaptashcharati shoshuchanah |
suprajah santsa udare na sarshadyo nashniyadanaduho vijanan ||
verses.en: Born an Indra among human beings (manuṣyà), he goes about (car) shining brightly, a heated hot-drink (gharmá); he, being one of good offspring, shall not go in mist (? udārá) who, understanding [it], shall not partake of (aç) the draft-ox.

verses.sa:
अनड्वान् दुहे सुकृतस्य लोक ऐनं प्याययति पवमानः पुरस्तात्।
पर्जन्यो धारा मरुत ऊधो अस्य यज्ञः पयो दक्षिणा दोहो अस्य ॥
verses.rom:
anadvan duhe sukritasya loka ainam pyayayati pavamanah purastat|
parjanyo dhara maruta udho asya yajnah payo dakshina doho asya ||
verses.en: The draft-ox yields milk (duh) in the world of the well-done; the purifying one fills him up from in front; Parjanya [is] his streams, the Maruts his udder, the sacrifice his milk, the sacrificial gift the milking of him.

verses.sa:
यस्य नेशे यज्ञपतिर्न यज्ञो नास्य दातेशे न प्रतिग्रहीता ।
यो विश्वजिद्विश्वभृद्विश्वकर्मा घर्मं नो ब्रूत यतमश्चतुष्पात् ॥
verses.rom:
yasya neshe yajnapatirna yajno nasya dateshe na pratigrahita |
yo vishvajidvishvabhridvishvakarma gharmam no bruta yatamashchatushpat ||
verses.en: Of whom the lord of the sacrifice is not master (īç), nor the sacrifice; not the giver is master of him, nor the acceptor; who is all-conquering, all-bearing, all-working—tell ye us the hot-drink which [is] four-footed.

verses.sa:
येन देवाः स्वरारुरुहुर्हित्वा शरीरममृतस्य नाभिम् ।
तेन गेष्म सुकृतस्य लोकं घर्मस्य व्रतेन तपसा यशस्यवः ॥
verses.rom:
yena devah svararuruhurhitva shariramamritasya nabhim |
tena geshma sukritasya lokam gharmasya vratena tapasa yashasyavah ||
verses.en: By whom the gods ascended to heaven (svàr), quitting the body, to the navel of the immortal, by him may we go to the world of the well-done, desiring glory, by the vow (vratá) of the hot-drink, by penance.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो रूपेणाग्निर्वहेन प्रजापतिः परमेष्ठी विराट्।
विश्वानरे अक्रमत वैश्वानरे अक्रमतानडुह्यक्रमत ।
सोऽदृंहयत सोऽधारयत ॥
verses.rom:
indro rupenagnirvahena prajapatih parameshthi virat|
vishvanare akramata vaishvanare akramatanaduhyakramata |
so'drimhayata so'dharayata ||
verses.en: Indra by form, Agni by carrying (váha), Prajāpati, Parameshṭhin, Virāj; in Viçvānara he strode, in Vāiçvānara he strode, in the draft-ox he strode; he made firm, he sustained.

verses.sa:
मध्यमेतदनडुहो यत्रैष वह आहितः ।
एतावदस्य प्राचीनं यावान् प्रत्यङ्समाहितः ॥
verses.rom:
madhyametadanaduho yatraisha vaha ahitah |
etavadasya prachinam yavan pratyansamahitah ||
verses.en: That is the middle of the draft-ox, where this carrying (váha) is set; so much of him is in front (prācī́na) as he is put all together on the opposite side.

verses.sa:
यो वेदानडुहो दोहान्त्सप्तानुपदस्वतः ।
प्रजां च लोकं चाप्नोति तथा सप्तऋषयो विदुः ॥
verses.rom:
yo vedanaduho dohantsaptanupadasvatah |
prajam cha lokam chapnoti tatha saptarishayo viduh ||
verses.en: Whoso knows the milkings of the draft-ox, seven, unfailing, both progeny and world he obtains: so the seven seers know.

verses.sa:
पद्भिः सेदिमवक्रामन्न् इरां जङ्घाभिरुत्खिदन् ।
श्रमेणानड्वान् कीलालं कीनाशश्चाभि गच्छतः ॥
verses.rom:
padbhih sedimavakramann iram janghabhirutkhidan |
shramenanadvan kilalam kinashashchabhi gachchhatah ||
verses.en: With his feet treading down debility (sedí), with his thighs (ján̄ghā) extracting (ut-khid) refreshing drink—with weariness go the draft-ox and the plowman unto sweet drink (kīlála).

verses.sa:
द्वादश वा एता रात्रीर्व्रत्या आहुः प्रजापतेः ।
तत्रोप ब्रह्म यो वेद तद्वा अनडुहो व्रतम् ॥
verses.rom:
dvadasha va eta ratrirvratya ahuh prajapateh |
tatropa brahma yo veda tadva anaduho vratam ||
verses.en: Twelve, indeed, they declare those nights of the vow (vrátya) of Prajāpati; whoso knows the bráhman within them (tátro ’pa)—that verily is the vow of the draft-ox.

verses.sa:
दुहे सायं दुहे प्रातर्दुहे मध्यंदिनं परि ।
दोहा ये अस्य संयन्ति तान् विद्मानुपदस्वतः ॥
verses.rom:
duhe sayam duhe pratarduhe madhyamdinam pari |
doha ye asya samyanti tan vidmanupadasvatah ||
verses.en: He milks (duh) at evening, he milks in the morning, he milks about midday; the milkings of him that come together, those unfailing ones we know.

verses.sa:
रोहण्यसि रोहण्यस्थ्नश्छिन्नस्य रोहणी ।
रोहयेदमरुन्धति ॥
verses.rom:
rohanyasi rohanyasthnashchhinnasya rohani |
rohayedamarundhati ||
verses.en: Grower art thou, grower; grower of severed bone; make this grow, O arundhatī́.

verses.sa:
यत्ते रिष्टं यत्ते द्युत्तमस्ति पेष्ट्रं त आत्मनि ।
धाता तद्भद्रया पुनः सं दधत्परुषा परुः ॥
verses.rom:
yatte rishtam yatte dyuttamasti peshtram ta atmani |
dhata tadbhadraya punah sam dadhatparusha paruh ||
verses.en: What of thee is torn (riç), what of thee is inflamed (? dyut), is crushed (? péṣṭra) in thyself—may Dhātar excellently put that together again, joint with joint.

verses.sa:
सं ते मज्जा मज्ज्ञा भवतु समु ते परुषा परुः ।
सं ते मांसस्य विस्रस्तं समस्थ्यपि रोहतु ॥
verses.rom:
sam te majja majjna bhavatu samu te parusha paruh |
sam te mamsasya visrastam samasthyapi rohatu ||
verses.en: Let thy marrow come together with marrow, and thy joint together with joint; together let what of thy flesh has fallen apart, together let thy bone grow over.

verses.sa:
मज्जा मज्ञा सं धीयतां चर्मणा चर्म रोहतु ।
असृक्ते अस्थि रोहतु मांसं मांसेन रोहतु ॥
verses.rom:
majja majna sam dhiyatam charmana charma rohatu |
asrikte asthi rohatu mamsam mamsena rohatu ||
verses.en: Let marrow be put together with marrow; let skin (cárman) grow (ruh) with skin; let thy blood, bone grow; let flesh grow with flesh.

verses.sa:
लोम लोम्ना सं कल्पया त्वचा सं कल्पया त्वचम् ।
असृक्ते अस्थि रोहतु छिन्नं सं धेह्योषधे ॥
verses.rom:
loma lomna sam kalpaya tvacha sam kalpaya tvacham |
asrikte asthi rohatu chhinnam sam dhehyoshadhe ||
verses.en: Fit thou together hair with hair; fit together skin (tvác) with skin; let thy blood, bone grow; put together what is severed, O herb.

verses.sa:
स उत्तिष्ठ प्रेहि प्र द्रव रथः सुचक्रः ।
सुपविः सुनाभिः प्रति तिष्ठोर्ध्वः ॥
verses.rom:
sa uttishtha prehi pra drava rathah suchakrah |
supavih sunabhih prati tishthordhvah ||
verses.en: Do thou here stand up, go forth, run forth, a chariot well-wheeled, well-tired, well-naved; stand firm upright.

verses.sa:
यदि कर्तं पतित्वा संशश्रे यदि वाश्मा प्रहृतो जघान ।
ऋभू रथस्येवाङ्गानि सं दधत्परुषा परुः ॥
verses.rom:
yadi kartam patitva samshashre yadi vashma prahrito jaghana |
ribhu rathasyevangani sam dadhatparusha paruh ||
verses.en: If, falling into a pit, he hath been crushed (sam-çṛ), or if a stone hurled (pra-kṛ) hath smitten [him]—as a Ṛbhu the parts of a chariot, may it put together joint with joint.

verses.sa:
उत देवा अवहितं देवा उन्नयथा पुनः ।
उतागश्चक्रुषं देवा देवा जीवयथा पुनः ॥
verses.rom:
uta deva avahitam deva unnayatha punah |
utagashchakrusham deva deva jivayatha punah ||
verses.en: Both, O ye gods, him that is put down, O ye gods, ye lead up again, and him that hath done evil (ā́gas), O ye gods, O ye gods, ye make to live again.

verses.sa:
द्वाविमौ वातौ वात आ सिन्धोरा परावतः ।
दक्षं ते अन्य आवातु व्यन्यो वातु यद्रपः ॥
verses.rom:
dvavimau vatau vata a sindhora paravatah |
daksham te anya avatu vyanyo vatu yadrapah ||
verses.en: These two winds blow from the river as far as the distance; let the one blow hither dexterity for thee; let the other blow away what complaint (rápas) [thou hast].

verses.sa:
आ वात वाहि भेषजं वि वात वाहि यद्रपः ।
त्वं हि विश्वभेषज देवानां दूत ईयसे ॥
verses.rom:
a vata vahi bheshajam vi vata vahi yadrapah |
tvam hi vishvabheshaja devanam duta iyase ||
verses.en: Hither, O wind, blow healing; away, O wind, blow what complaint [there is]; for thou, all-healing one, goest [as] messenger of the gods.

verses.sa:
त्रायन्तामिमं देवास्त्रायन्तां मरुतां गणाः ।
त्रायन्तां विश्वा भूतानि यथायमरपा असत् ॥
verses.rom:
trayantamimam devastrayantam marutam ganah |
trayantam vishva bhutani yathayamarapa asat ||
verses.en: Let the gods rescue this man, let the troops of Maruts rescue, let all beings rescue, that this man may be free from complaints.

verses.sa:
आ त्वागमं शंतातिभिरथो अरिष्टतातिभिः ।
दक्षं त उग्रमाभारिषं परा यक्ष्मं सुवामि ते ॥
verses.rom:
a tvagamam shamtatibhiratho arishtatatibhih |
daksham ta ugramabharisham para yakshmam suvami te ||
verses.en: I have come unto thee with wealfulnesses, likewise with uninjurednesses; I have brought for thee formidable dexterity; I drive (sū) away for thee the yákṣma.

verses.sa:
अयं मे हस्तो भगवान् अयं मे भगवत्तरः ।
अयं मे विश्वभेषजोऽयं शिवाभिमर्शनः ॥
verses.rom:
ayam me hasto bhagavan ayam me bhagavattarah |
ayam me vishvabheshajo'yam shivabhimarshanah ||
verses.en: This is my fortunate hand, this my more fortunate one, this my all-healing one; this is of propitious touch.

verses.sa:
हस्ताभ्यां दशशाखाभ्यां जिह्वा वाचः पुरोगवी ।
अनामयित्नुभ्यां हस्ताभ्यां ताभ्यां त्वाभि मृशामसि ॥
verses.rom:
hastabhyam dashashakhabhyam jihva vachah purogavi |
anamayitnubhyam hastabhyam tabhyam tvabhi mrishamasi ||
verses.en: With (two) ten-branched hands—the tongue [is] forerunner of voice—with (two) disease-removing hands: with them do we touch thee.

verses.sa:
अजो ह्यग्नेरजनिष्ट शोकात्सो अपश्यज्जनितारमग्रे ।
तेन देवा देवतामग्र आयन् तेन रोहान् रुरुहुर्मेध्यासः ॥
verses.rom:
ajo hyagnerajanishta shokatso apashyajjanitaramagre |
tena deva devatamagra ayan tena rohan ruruhurmedhyasah ||
verses.en: Since the goat has been born from the heat of Agni (the fire), it saw [its] generator in the beginning; by it the gods in the beginnings attained (i) [their] godhead; by (with?) it the sacrificial ones (médhya) ascended the ascents (róha).

verses.sa:
क्रमध्वमग्निना नाकमुख्यान् हस्तेषु बिभ्रतः ।
दिवस्पृष्ठं स्वर्गत्वा मिश्रा देवेभिराध्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
kramadhvamagnina nakamukhyan hasteshu bibhratah |
divasprishtham svargatva mishra devebhiradhvam ||
verses.en: Stride ye with the fire to the firmament (nā́ka), bearing in your hands vessel-[fires] (úkhya); having gone to the back of the sky, to the heaven (svàr), sit ye mingled with the gods.

verses.sa:
पृष्ठात्पृथिव्या अहमन्तरिक्षमारुहमन्तरिक्षाद्दिवमारुहम् ।
दिवो नाकस्य पृष्ठात्स्वर्ज्योतिरगामहम् ॥
verses.rom:
prishthatprithivya ahamantarikshamaruhamantarikshaddivamaruham |
divo nakasya prishthatsvarjyotiragamaham ||
verses.en: From the back of earth I have ascended to the atmosphere; from the atmosphere I have ascended to the sky; from the back of the sky, of the firmament (nā́ka), I have gone to heaven (svàr), to light.

verses.sa:
स्वर्यन्तो नापेक्षन्त आ द्यां रोहन्ति रोदसी ।
यज्ञं ये विश्वतोधारं सुविद्वांसो वितेनिरे ॥
verses.rom:
svaryanto napekshanta a dyam rohanti rodasi |
yajnam ye vishvatodharam suvidvamso vitenire ||
verses.en: Going to heaven (svàr) they look not away; they ascend to the sky, the two firmaments (ródasī)—they who, well-knowing, have extended the everywhere-streaming sacrifice.

verses.sa:
अग्ने प्रेहि प्रथमो देवतानां चक्षुर्देवानामुत मानुषाणाम् ।
इयक्षमाणा भृगुभिः सजोषाः स्वर्यन्तु यजमानाः स्वस्ति ॥
verses.rom:
agne prehi prathamo devatanam chakshurdevanamuta manushanam |
iyakshamana bhrigubhih sajoshah svaryantu yajamanah svasti ||
verses.en: O Agni, go forth first of the divinities, eye of gods and of human beings (mā́nuṣa)—pressing on (? íyakṣa-) in unison with the Bhṛgus, let the sacrificers go to heaven (svàr), to well-being.

verses.sa:
अजमनज्मि पयसा घृतेन दिव्यं सुपर्णं पयसं बृहन्तम् ।
तेन गेष्म सुकृतस्य लोकं स्वरारोहन्तो अभि नाकमुत्तमम् ॥
verses.rom:
ajamanajmi payasa ghritena divyam suparnam payasam brihantam |
tena geshma sukritasya lokam svararohanto abhi nakamuttamam ||
verses.en: With milk, with ghee, I anoint the goat, the heavenly eagle, milky, great; by it may we go to the world of the well-done, ascending the heaven (svàr), unto the highest firmament (nā́ka).

verses.sa:
पञ्चौदनं पञ्चभिरङ्गुलिभिर्दर्व्योद्धर पञ्चधैतमोदनम् ।
प्राच्यां दिशि शिरो अजस्य धेहि दक्षिणायां दिशि दक्षिणं धेहि पार्श्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
panchaudanam panchabhirangulibhirdarvyoddhara panchadhaitamodanam |
prachyam dishi shiro ajasya dhehi dakshinayam dishi dakshinam dhehi parshvam ||
verses.en: Accompanied by five rice-messes (-odaná), by the five fingers, with the spoon, take thou up five-fold that rice-mess. In the eastern quarter set thou the head of the goat; in the southern (dákṣiṇa) quarter set his right (dákṣiṇa) side.

verses.sa:
प्रतीच्यां दिशि भसदमस्य धेह्युत्तरस्यां दिश्युत्तरं धेहि पार्श्वम् ।
ऊर्ध्वायां दिश्यजस्यानूकं धेहि दिशि ध्रुवायां धेहि पाजस्यमन्तरिक्षे मध्यतो मध्यमस्य ॥
verses.rom:
pratichyam dishi bhasadamasya dhehyuttarasyam dishyuttaram dhehi parshvam |
urdhvayam dishyajasyanukam dhehi dishi dhruvayam dhehi pajasyamantarikshe madhyato madhyamasya ||
verses.en: In the western quarter set his rump (bhasád); in the northern (úttara) quarter set his other (úttara) side; in the upward quarter set the goat's back-bone; in the fixed quarter set his belly (? pājasyà); midway in the atmosphere his middle.

verses.sa:
शृतमजं शृतया प्रोर्णुहि त्वचा सर्वैरङ्गैः संभृतं विश्वरूपम् ।
स उत् तिष्ठेतो अभि नाकमुत्तमं पद्भिश्चतुर्भिः प्रति तिष्ठ दिक्षु ॥
verses.rom:
shritamajam shritaya prornuhi tvacha sarvairangaih sambhritam vishvarupam |
sa ut tishtheto abhi nakamuttamam padbhishchaturbhih prati tishtha dikshu ||
verses.en: Do thou envelop with cooked skin the cooked goat, brought

verses.sa:
समुत्पतन्तु प्रदिशो नभस्वतीः समभ्राणि वातजूतानि यन्तु ।
महऋषभस्य नदतो नभस्वतो वाश्रा आपः पृथिवीं तर्पयन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
samutpatantu pradisho nabhasvatih samabhrani vatajutani yantu |
maharishabhasya nadato nabhasvato vashra apah prithivim tarpayantu ||
verses.en: Let the directions, full of mist (nábhasvant), fly up together; let clouds, wind-hurried, come together; let the lowing [cows] of the resounding misty great bull, the waters, gratify the earth.

verses.sa:
समीक्षयन्तु तविषाः सुदानवोऽपां रसा ओषधीभिः सचन्ताम् ।
वर्षस्य सर्गा महयन्तु भूमिं पृथग्जायन्तामोषधयो विश्वरूपाः ॥
verses.rom:
samikshayantu tavishah sudanavo'pam rasa oshadhibhih sachantam |
varshasya sarga mahayantu bhumim prithagjayantamoshadhayo vishvarupah ||
verses.en: Let the mighty (taviṣá), liberal (sudā́nu) ones cause to behold together; let the juices (rása) of the waters attach themselves (sac) to the herbs; let gushes (sárga) of rain gladden (mahay-) the earth; let herbs of all forms be born here and there (pṛ́thak).

verses.sa:
समीक्षयस्व गायतो नभांस्यपां वेगासः पृथगुद्विजन्ताम् ।
वर्षस्य सर्गा महयन्तु भूमिं पृथग्जायन्तां वीरुधो विश्वरूपाः ॥
verses.rom:
samikshayasva gayato nabhamsyapam vegasah prithagudvijantam |
varshasya sarga mahayantu bhumim prithagjayantam virudho vishvarupah ||
verses.en: Do thou make the singers (gā́yant) to behold together the mists;

verses.sa:
गणास्त्वोप गायन्तु मारुताः पर्जन्य घोषिणः पृथक्।
सर्गा वर्षस्य वर्षतो वर्षन्तु पृथिवीमनु ॥
verses.rom:
ganastvopa gayantu marutah parjanya ghoshinah prithak|
sarga varshasya varshato varshantu prithivimanu ||
verses.en: Let the troops of Maruts sing unto thee, O Parjanya, noisy here and there; let gushes of raining rain rain along the earth.

verses.sa:
उदीरयत मरुतः समुद्रतस्त्वेषो अर्को नभ उत्पातयाथ ।
महऋषभस्य नदतो नभस्वतो वाश्रा आपः पृथिवीं तर्पयन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
udirayata marutah samudratastvesho arko nabha utpatayatha |
maharishabhasya nadato nabhasvato vashra apah prithivim tarpayantu ||
verses.en: Send up, O Maruts, from the ocean; brilliant [is] the song; ye make the mist fly up; let the lowing [cows] of the resounding misty great bull, the waters, gratify the earth.

verses.sa:
अभि क्रन्द स्तनयार्दयोदधिं भूमिं पर्जन्य पयसा समङ्धि ।
त्वया सृष्टं बहुलमैतु वर्षमाशारैषी कृशगुरेत्वस्तम् ॥
verses.rom:
abhi kranda stanayardayodadhim bhumim parjanya payasa samandhi |
tvaya srishtam bahulamaitu varshamasharaishi krishaguretvastam ||
verses.en: Roar on, thunder, excite (ard) the water-holder; anoint the earth, O Parjanya, with milk; by thee poured out, let abundant rain come; let him of lean kine, seeking refuge, go home.

verses.sa:
सं वोऽवन्तु सुदानव उत्सा अजगरा उत ।
मरुद्भिः प्रच्युता मेघा वर्षन्तु पृथिवीमनु ॥
verses.rom:
sam vo'vantu sudanava utsa ajagara uta |
marudbhih prachyuta megha varshantu prithivimanu ||
verses.en: Let the liberal ones favor (sam-av) you, also the fountains, great serpents (ajagará); let the clouds, started forward by the Maruts, rain along the earth.

verses.sa:
आशामाशां वि द्योततां वाता वान्तु दिशोदिशः ।
मरुद्भिः प्रच्युता मेघाः सं यन्तु पृथिवीमनु ॥
verses.rom:
ashamasham vi dyotatam vata vantu dishodishah |
marudbhih prachyuta meghah sam yantu prithivimanu ||
verses.en: Let it lighten to every region (ā́çā); let the winds blow to (from ?) every quarter; let the clouds, started forward by the Maruts, come together along the earth.

verses.sa:
आपो विद्युदभ्रं वर्षं सं वोऽवन्तु सुदानव उत्सा अजगरा उत ।
मरुद्भिः प्रच्युता मेघाः प्रावन्तु पृथिवीमनु ॥
verses.rom:
apo vidyudabhram varsham sam vo'vantu sudanava utsa ajagara uta |
marudbhih prachyuta meghah pravantu prithivimanu ||
verses.en: Waters, lightning, cloud, rain—let the liberal ones favor you, also the fountains, great serpents; let the clouds, started forward by the Maruts, show favor (pra-av) along the earth.

verses.sa:
अपामग्निस्तनूभिः संविदानो य ओषधीनामधिपा बभूव ।
स नो वर्षं वनुतां जातवेदाः प्राणं प्रजाभ्यो अमृतं दिवस्परि ॥
verses.rom:
apamagnistanubhih samvidano ya oshadhinamadhipa babhuva |
sa no varsham vanutam jatavedah pranam prajabhyo amritam divaspari ||
verses.en: Agni, who, in unison with the waters' selves (tanū́), hath become overlord of the herbs—let him, Jātavedas, win (van) for us rain, breath for [our] progeny, amṛ́ta out of the sky.

verses.sa:
प्रजापतिः सलिलादा समुद्रादाप ईरयन्न् उदधिमर्दयाति ।
प्र प्यायतां वृष्णो अश्वस्य रेतोऽर्वान् एतेन स्तनयित्नुनेहि ॥
verses.rom:
prajapatih salilada samudradapa irayann udadhimardayati |
pra pyayatam vrishno ashvasya reto'rvan etena stanayitnunehi ||
verses.en: May Prajāpati from the sea, the ocean, sending waters, excite the water-holder; let the seed of the stallion (vṛ́ṣan áçva) be filled up; come hitherward with that thunder,—

verses.sa:
अपो निषिञ्चन्न् असुरः पिता नः श्वसन्तु गर्गरा अपां वरुणाव नीचीरपः सृज ।
वदन्तु पृश्निबाहवो मण्डूका इरिणानु ॥
verses.rom:
apo nishinchann asurah pita nah shvasantu gargara apam varunava nichirapah srija |
vadantu prishnibahavo manduka irinanu ||
verses.en: Pouring down waters, our Asura father.

verses.sa:
संवत्सरं शशयाना ब्राह्मणा व्रतचारिणः ।
वाचं पर्जन्यजिन्वितां प्र मण्डूका अवादिषुः ॥
verses.rom:
samvatsaram shashayana brahmana vratacharinah |
vacham parjanyajinvitam pra manduka avadishuh ||
verses.en: Having lain for a year, [like] Brahmans performing a vow, the frogs have spoken forth a voice quickened by Parjanya.

verses.sa:
उपप्रवद मण्डूकि वर्षमा वद तादुरि ।
मध्ये ह्रदस्य प्लवस्व विगृह्य चतुरः पदः ॥
verses.rom:
upapravada manduki varshama vada taduri |
madhye hradasya plavasva vigrihya chaturah padah ||
verses.en: Speak forth unto [it], O she-frog; speak to the rain, O tādurī; swim in the midst of the pool, spreading thy four feet.

verses.sa:
खण्वखा३ खैमखा३ मध्ये तदुरि ।
वर्षं वनुध्वं पितरो मरुतां मन इच्छत ॥
verses.rom:
khanvakha3 khaimakha3 madhye taduri |
varsham vanudhvam pitaro marutam mana ichchhata ||
verses.en: O khaṇvakhā! O khāimakhā! in the middle, O tadurī! win ye rain, O Fathers; seek the favor (mánas) of the Maruts.

verses.sa:
महान्तं कोशमुदचाभि षिञ्च सविद्युतं भवतु वातु वातः ।
तन्वतां यज्ञं बहुधा विसृष्टा आनन्दिनीरोषधयो भवन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
mahantam koshamudachabhi shincha savidyutam bhavatu vatu vatah |
tanvatam yajnam bahudha visrishta anandiniroshadhayo bhavantu ||
verses.en: The great vessel (kóça) do thou draw up (ud-ac); pour on; let

verses.sa:
बृहन्न् एषामधिष्ठाता अन्तिकादिव पश्यति ।
य स्तायन् मन्यते चरन्त्सर्वं देवा इदं विदुः ॥
verses.rom:
brihann eshamadhishthata antikadiva pashyati |
ya stayan manyate charantsarvam deva idam viduh ||
verses.en: The great superintendent of them sees, as it were, from close by; whoever thinks to be going on in secret, all this the gods know.

verses.sa:
यस्तिष्ठति चरति यश्च वञ्चति यो निलायं चरति यः प्रतङ्कम् ।
द्वौ संनिषद्य यन् मन्त्रयेते राजा तद्वेद वरुणस्तृतीयः ॥
verses.rom:
yastishthati charati yashcha vanchati yo nilayam charati yah pratankam |
dvau samnishadya yan mantrayete raja tadveda varunastritiyah ||
verses.en: Whoso stands, goes about, and whoso goes crookedly (vañc), whoso goes about hiddenly, who defiantly (? pratán̄kam)—what two, sitting down together, talk, king Varuṇa, as third, knows that.

verses.sa:
उतेयं भूमिर्वरुणस्य राज्ञ उतासौ द्यौर्बृहती दूरेअन्ता ।
उतो समुद्रौ वरुणस्य कुक्षी उतास्मिन्न् अल्प उदके निलीनः ॥
verses.rom:
uteyam bhumirvarunasya rajna utasau dyaurbrihati dureanta |
uto samudrau varunasya kukshi utasminn alpa udake nilinah ||
verses.en: Both this earth is king Varuṇa's, and yonder great sky with distant margins (-ánta); also the two oceans are Varuṇa's paunches; also in this petty water is he hidden.

verses.sa:
उत यो द्यामतिसर्पात्परस्तान् न स मुच्यातै वरुणस्य राज्ञः ।
दिव स्पशः प्र चरन्तीदमस्य सहस्राक्षा अति पश्यन्ति भूमिम् ॥
verses.rom:
uta yo dyamatisarpatparastan na sa muchyatai varunasya rajnah |
diva spashah pra charantidamasya sahasraksha ati pashyanti bhumim ||
verses.en: Also whoso should creep far off beyond the sky, he should not be released from king Varuṇa; from the sky his spies go forth hither; thousand-eyed, they look over the earth.

verses.sa:
सर्वं तद्राजा वरुणो वि चष्टे यदन्तरा रोदसी यत्परस्तात्।
संख्याता अस्य निमिषो जनानामक्षान् इव श्वघ्नी नि मिनोति तानि ॥
verses.rom:
sarvam tadraja varuno vi chashte yadantara rodasi yatparastat|
samkhyata asya nimisho jananamakshan iva shvaghni ni minoti tani ||
verses.en: All this king Varuna beholds (vi-cakṣ)—what is between the two firmaments (ródasī), what beyond; numbered of him are the winkings of people; as a gambler the dice, [so] does he fix (? ni-mi) these things.

verses.sa:
ये ते पाशा वरुण सप्तसप्त त्रेधा तिष्ठन्ति विषिता रुषन्तः ।
छिनन्तु सर्वे अनृतं वदन्तं यः सत्यवाद्यति तं सृजन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
ye te pasha varuna saptasapta tredha tishthanti vishita rushantah |
chhinantu sarve anritam vadantam yah satyavadyati tam srijantu ||
verses.en: What fetters (pā́ça) of thine, O Varuṇa, seven by seven, stand triply relaxed (vi-si), shining—let them all bind him that speaks untruth; whoso is truth-speaking, let them let him go.

verses.sa:
शतेन पाशैरभि धेहि वरुणैनं मा ते मोच्यनृतवाङ्नृचक्षः ।
आस्तां जाल्म उदरं श्रंशयित्वा कोश इवाबन्धः परिकृत्यमानः ॥
verses.rom:
shatena pashairabhi dhehi varunainam ma te mochyanritavannrichakshah |
astam jalma udaram shramshayitva kosha ivabandhah parikrityamanah ||
verses.en: With a hundred fetters, O Varuṇa, do thou bridle (abhi-dhā) him; let not the speaker of untruth escape thee, O men-watcher; let the villain sit letting his belly fall [apart], like a hoopless vessel, being cut round about.

verses.sa:
यः समाभ्यो वरुणो यो व्याभ्यो यः संदेश्यो वरुणो यो विदेश्यो ।
यो दैवो वरुणो यश्च मानुषः ॥
verses.rom:
yah samabhyo varuno yo vyabhyo yah samdeshyo varuno yo videshyo |
yo daivo varuno yashcha manushah ||
verses.en: The Varuṇa that is lengthwise (samāmyà), that is crosswise (vyāmyà); the Varuṇa that is of the same region (saṁdeçyà), that is of a different region (videçyà); the Varuṇa that is of the gods, and that is of men—

verses.sa:
तैस्त्वा सर्वैरभि ष्यामि पाशैरसावामुष्यायणामुष्याः पुत्र ।
तान् उ ते सर्वान् अनुसंदिशामि ॥
verses.rom:
taistva sarvairabhi shyami pashairasavamushyayanamushyah putra |
tan u te sarvan anusamdishami ||
verses.en: With all those fetters I fasten (abhi-sā) thee, O so-and-so, of such-and-such a family, son of such-and-such a mother; and all of them I successively appoint for thee.

verses.sa:
ईशाणां त्वा भेषजानामुज्जेष आ रभामहे ।
चक्रे सहस्रवीर्यं सर्वस्मा ओषधे त्वा ॥
verses.rom:
ishanam tva bheshajanamujjesha a rabhamahe |
chakre sahasraviryam sarvasma oshadhe tva ||
verses.en: Thee, the mistress of remedies, O conquering one (ujjeṣá), we take hold of; I have made thee a thing of thousand-fold energy (-vīryà) for every one, O herb.

verses.sa:
सत्यजितं शपथयावनीं सहमानां पुनःसराम् ।
सर्वाः समह्व्योषधीरितो नः पारयादिति ॥
verses.rom:
satyajitam shapathayavanim sahamanam punahsaram |
sarvah samahvyoshadhirito nah parayaditi ||
verses.en: The truly-conquering, the curse-repelling, the overcoming, the reverted one (punaḥsará)—all the herbs have I called together, saying "may they (?) save us from this."

verses.sa:
या शशाप शपनेन याघं मूरमादधे ।
या रसस्य हरणाय जातमारेभे तोकमत्तु सा ॥
verses.rom:
ya shashapa shapanena yagham muramadadhe |
ya rasasya haranaya jatamarebhe tokamattu sa ||
verses.en: She that hath cursed with cursing, that hath taken malignity as her root, that hath seized on [our] young to take [its] sap—let her eat [her own] offspring.

verses.sa:
यां ते चक्रुरामे पात्रे यां चक्रुर्नीललोहिते ।
आमे मांसे कृत्यां यां चक्रुस्तया कृत्याकृतो जहि ॥
verses.rom:
yam te chakrurame patre yam chakrurnilalohite |
ame mamse krityam yam chakrustaya krityakrito jahi ||
verses.en: What [witchcraft] they have made for thee in the raw vessel (pā́tra), what they have made in the blue-red one, in raw flesh what witchcraft they have made—with that do thou smite the witchcraft-makers.

verses.sa:
दौष्वप्न्यं दौर्जीवित्यं रक्षो अभ्वमराय्यः ।
दुर्णाम्नीः सर्वा दुर्वाचस्ता अस्मन् नाशयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
daushvapnyam daurjivityam raksho abhvamarayyah |
durnamnih sarva durvachasta asman nashayamasi ||
verses.en: Evil-dreaming, evil-living, demon, monster (abhvà), hags, all the ill-named (f.), ill-voiced—them we make disappear from us.

verses.sa:
क्षुधामारं तृष्णामारमगोतामनपत्यताम् ।
अपामार्ग त्वया वयं सर्वं तदप मृज्महे ॥
verses.rom:
kshudhamaram trishnamaramagotamanapatyatam |
apamarga tvaya vayam sarvam tadapa mrijmahe ||
verses.en: Death by hunger, death by thirst, kinelessness, childlessness—through thee, O off-wiper (apāmārgá), we wipe off all that.

verses.sa:
तृष्णामारं क्षुधामारमथो अक्षपराजयम् ।
अपामार्ग त्वया वयं सर्वं तदप मृज्महे ॥
verses.rom:
trishnamaram kshudhamaramatho akshaparajayam |
apamarga tvaya vayam sarvam tadapa mrijmahe ||
verses.en: Death by thirst, death by hunger, likewise defeat at dice—through thee, O off-wiper, we wipe off all that.

verses.sa:
अपामार्ग ओषधीनां सर्वासामेक इद्वशी ।
तेन ते मृज्म आस्थितमथ त्वमगदश्चर ॥
verses.rom:
apamarga oshadhinam sarvasameka idvashi |
tena te mrijma asthitamatha tvamagadashchara ||
verses.en: The off-wiper is indeed of all herbs the sole controller (vaçín); with it we wipe [off] what has befallen (ā́sthita) thee; then do thou go about free from disease.

verses.sa:
समं ज्योतिः सूर्येणाह्ना रात्री समावती ।
कृणोमि सत्यमूतयेऽरसाः सन्तु कृत्वरीः ॥
verses.rom:
samam jyotih suryenahna ratri samavati |
krinomi satyamutaye'rasah santu kritvarih ||
verses.en: The same light with the sun—night possesses the same with the day; I make what is effective (satyá) for aid; sapless be the makers (f.) [of witchcraft].

verses.sa:
यो देवाः कृत्यां कृत्वा हरादविदुषो गृहम् ।
वत्सो धारुरिव मातरं तं प्रत्यगुप पद्यताम् ॥
verses.rom:
yo devah krityam kritva haradavidusho griham |
vatso dharuriva mataram tam pratyagupa padyatam ||
verses.en: Whoso, O gods, having made witchcraft, shall take it to the house of one unknowing—let it, like a sucking (dhārú) calf to its mother, go back unto him.

verses.sa:
अमा कृत्वा पाप्मानं यस्तेनान्यं जिघांसति ।
अश्मानस्तस्यां दग्धायां बहुलाः फट्करिक्रति ॥
verses.rom:
ama kritva papmanam yastenanyam jighamsati |
ashmanastasyam dagdhayam bahulah phatkarikrati ||
verses.en: Whoso, having made evil at home, desires to slay another with it—numerous stones make a loud crash when it (f.) is burned.

verses.sa:
सहस्रधामन् विशिखान् विग्रीवां छायया त्वम् ।
प्रति स्म चक्रुषे कृत्यां प्रियां प्रियावते हर ॥
verses.rom:
sahasradhaman vishikhan vigrivam chhayaya tvam |
prati sma chakrushe krityam priyam priyavate hara ||
verses.en: O thou of a thousand abodes (? -dhā́man), do thou make them lie (?) crestless, neckless; take back the witchcraft to him that made it, like a sweet-heart (priyā́) to a lover (priyā́vant).

verses.sa:
अनयाहमोषध्या सर्वाः कृत्या अदूदुषम् ।
यां क्षेत्रे चक्रुर्यां गोषु यां वा ते पुरुषेषु ॥
verses.rom:
anayahamoshadhya sarvah kritya adudusham |
yam kshetre chakruryam goshu yam va te purusheshu ||
verses.en: I, with this herb, have spoiled all witchcrafts—what one they have made in the field, what in the kine, or what in thy men (púruṣa).

verses.sa:
यश्चकार न शशाक कर्तुं शश्रे पादमङ्गुरिम् ।
चकार भद्रमस्मभ्यमात्मने तपनं तु सः ॥
verses.rom:
yashchakara na shashaka kartum shashre padamangurim |
chakara bhadramasmabhyamatmane tapanam tu sah ||
verses.en: He who hath made hath not been able to make; he hath crushed (çṛ) a foot, a finger; he hath made what is excellent for us, but for himself a burning (tápana).

verses.sa:
अपामार्गोऽप मार्ष्टु क्षेत्रियं शपथश्च यः ।
अपाह यातुधानीरप सर्वा अराय्यः ॥
verses.rom:
apamargo'pa marshtu kshetriyam shapathashcha yah |
apaha yatudhanirapa sarva arayyah ||
verses.en: Let the off-wiper wipe off the kṣetriyá and whatever curse [there is]; [wipe] off, forsooth, the sorceresses, off all the hags.

verses.sa:
अपमृज्य यातुधानान् अप सर्वा अराय्यः ।
अपामार्ग त्वया वयं सर्वं तदप मृज्महे ॥
verses.rom:
apamrijya yatudhanan apa sarva arayyah |
apamarga tvaya vayam sarvam tadapa mrijmahe ||
verses.en: Having wiped off the sorcerers, off all the hags, O off-wiper, with thee do we wipe off all that.

verses.sa:
उतो अस्यबन्धुकृदुतो असि नु जामिकृत्।
उतो कृत्याकृतः प्रजां नदमिवा छिन्धि वार्षिकम् ॥
verses.rom:
uto asyabandhukriduto asi nu jamikrit|
uto krityakritah prajam nadamiva chhindhi varshikam ||
verses.en: Both art thou not relative-making, and now art thou kin-making; also do thou cut off (? ā-chid) the progeny of the witchcraft-maker, like a reed of the rainy season (vā́rṣika).

verses.sa:
ब्राह्मणेन पर्युक्तासि कण्वेन नार्षदेन ।
सेनेवैषि त्विषीमती न तत्र भयमस्ति यत्र प्राप्नोष्योषधे ॥
verses.rom:
brahmanena paryuktasi kanvena narshadena |
senevaishi tvishimati na tatra bhayamasti yatra prapnoshyoshadhe ||
verses.en: Thou art bespoken (?) by a Brāhman, by Kaṇva son of Nṛshad; thou goest like a brilliant army (?); there is no fear (bhayá) there where thou arrivest (pra-āp), O herb.

verses.sa:
अग्रमेष्योषधीनां ज्योतिषेवाभिदीपयन् ।
उत त्रातासि पाकस्याथो हन्तासि रक्षसः ॥
verses.rom:
agrameshyoshadhinam jyotishevabhidipayan |
uta tratasi pakasyatho hantasi rakshasah ||
verses.en: Thou goest to the head (ágra) of the herbs, causing to shine (dīp) upon [us] as it were with light; also rescuer art thou of the simple (pā́ka), likewise slayer art thou of the demoniac.

verses.sa:
यददो देवा असुरांस्त्वयाग्रे निरकुर्वत ।
ततस्त्वमध्योषधेऽपामार्गो अजायथाः ॥
verses.rom:
yadado deva asuramstvayagre nirakurvata |
tatastvamadhyoshadhe'pamargo ajayathah ||
verses.en: When yonder, in the beginning, the gods by thee removed (nis-kṛ) the Asuras, from thence, O herb, wast thou born, an off-wiper.

verses.sa:
विभिन्दती शतशाखा विभिन्दन् नाम ते पिता ।
प्रत्यग्वि भिन्धि त्वं तं यो अस्मामभिदासति ॥
verses.rom:
vibhindati shatashakha vibhindan nama te pita |
pratyagvi bhindhi tvam tam yo asmamabhidasati ||
verses.en: Splitting apart (vi-bhid), hundred-branched—"splitting apart" by name is thy father; in return (pratyák), do thou split apart him who assails us.

verses.sa:
असद्भूम्याः समभवत्तद्यामेति महद्व्यचः ।
तद्वै ततो विधूपायत्प्रत्यक्कर्तारमृच्छतु ॥
verses.rom:
asadbhumyah samabhavattadyameti mahadvyachah |
tadvai tato vidhupayatpratyakkartaramrichchhatu ||
verses.en: The non-existent came into being (sam-bhū) from the earth; that

verses.sa:
प्रत्यङ्हि संबभूविथ प्रतीचीनफलस्त्वम् ।
सर्वान् मच्छपथामधि वरीयो यावया वधम् ॥
verses.rom:
pratyanhi sambabhuvitha pratichinaphalastvam |
sarvan machchhapathamadhi variyo yavaya vadham ||
verses.en: Since thou hast come into being reverted (pratyáñc), having reverted fruit, do thou repel (yu) from me all curses, [repel] very far the deadly weapon.

verses.sa:
शतेन मा परि पाहि सहस्रेणाभि रक्षा मा ।
इन्द्रस्ते वीरुधां पत उग्र ओज्मानमा दधत् ॥
verses.rom:
shatena ma pari pahi sahasrenabhi raksha ma |
indraste virudham pata ugra ojmanama dadhat ||
verses.en: Protect me around with a hundred; defend me with a thousand; may the forceful (ugrá) Indra, O lord of the plants, assign force (ojmán) unto thee.

verses.sa:
आ पश्यति प्रति पश्यति परा पश्यति पश्यति ।
दिवमन्तरिक्षमाद्भूमिं सर्वं तद्देवि पश्यति ॥
verses.rom:
a pashyati prati pashyati para pashyati pashyati |
divamantarikshamadbhumim sarvam taddevi pashyati ||
verses.en: He (?) looks on, he looks toward, he looks away, he looks: the sky, the atmosphere, then the earth—all that, O divine one (f.), he looks at.

verses.sa:
तिस्रो दिवस्तिस्रः पृथिवीः षट्चेमाः प्रदिशाः पृथक्।
त्वयाहं सर्वा भूतानि पश्यानि देव्योषधे ॥
verses.rom:
tisro divastisrah prithivih shatchemah pradishah prithak|
tvayaham sarva bhutani pashyani devyoshadhe ||
verses.en: Three skies, three earths, and these six directions severally—by thee let me see all beings, O divine herb.

verses.sa:
दिव्यस्य सुपर्णस्य तस्य हासि कनीनिका ।
सा भूमिमा रुरोहिथ वह्यं श्रान्ता वधूरिव ॥
verses.rom:
divyasya suparnasya tasya hasi kaninika |
sa bhumima rurohitha vahyam shranta vadhuriva ||
verses.en: Of that heavenly eagle art thou the eye-pupil; thou here hast ascended the earth as a wearied bride (vadhū́) a litter.

verses.sa:
तां मे सहस्राक्षो देवो दक्षिणे हस्त आ दधत्।
तयाहं सर्वं पश्यामि यश्च शूद्र उतार्यः ॥
verses.rom:
tam me sahasraksho devo dakshine hasta a dadhat|
tayaham sarvam pashyami yashcha shudra utaryah ||
verses.en: May the thousand-eyed god set it in my right hand; with it do I see every one, both who is Çūdra and [who] Āryan.

verses.sa:
आविष्कृणुष्व रूपाणि मात्मानमप गूहथाः ।
अथो सहस्रचक्षो त्वं प्रति पश्याः किमीदिनः ॥
verses.rom:
avishkrinushva rupani matmanamapa guhathah |
atho sahasrachaksho tvam prati pashyah kimidinah ||
verses.en: Make manifest [thy] forms; do not hide thyself away; then mayest thou, O thousand-eyed one, look upon the kimīdíns.

verses.sa:
दर्शय मा यातुधानान् दर्शय यातुधान्यः ।
पिशाचान्त्सर्वान् दर्शयेति त्वा रभ ओषधे ॥
verses.rom:
darshaya ma yatudhanan darshaya yatudhanyah |
pishachantsarvan darshayeti tva rabha oshadhe ||
verses.en: Show me the sorcerers; show the sorceresses; show all the piçācás: with this intent I take hold of (ā-rabh) thee, O herb.

verses.sa:
कश्यपस्य चक्षुरसि शुन्याश्च चतुरक्ष्याः ।
वीध्रे सूर्यमिव सर्पन्तं मा पिशाचं तिरस्करः ॥
verses.rom:
kashyapasya chakshurasi shunyashcha chaturakshyah |
vidhre suryamiva sarpantam ma pishacham tiraskarah ||
verses.en: The eye of Kaçyapa art thou, and of the four-eyed bitch; conceal thou not the piçācá, like the sun gliding (sṛp) in the clear sky (vīdhrá).

verses.sa:
उदग्रभं परिपाणाद्यातुधानं किमीदिनम् ।
तेनाहं सर्वं पश्याम्युत शूद्रमुतार्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
udagrabham paripanadyatudhanam kimidinam |
tenaham sarvam pashyamyuta shudramutaryam ||
verses.en: I have seized (ud-grabh) out of his shelter (paripā́ṇa) the sorcerer, the kimīdín; with it do I see every one, both Çūdra and Āryan.

verses.sa:
यो अन्तरिक्षेण पतति दिवं यश्च अतिसर्पति ।
भूमिं यो मन्यते नाथं तं पिशाचं प्र दर्शय ॥
verses.rom:
yo antarikshena patati divam yashcha atisarpati |
bhumim yo manyate natham tam pishacham pra darshaya ||
verses.en: Whichever flies through the atmosphere, and whichever creeps across the sky; whichever thinks the earth a refuge (nāthá)—that piçācá do thou show forth.

verses.sa:
आ गावो अग्मन्न् उत भद्रमक्रन्त्सीदन्तु गोष्ठे रणयन्त्वस्मे ।
प्रजावतीः पुरुरूपा इह स्युरिन्द्राय पूर्वीरुषसो दुहानाः ॥
verses.rom:
a gavo agmann uta bhadramakrantsidantu goshthe ranayantvasme |
prajavatih pururupa iha syurindraya purvirushaso duhanah ||
verses.en: The kine have come, and have done what is excellent; let them stay (sad) in the stall (goṣṭhá); let them take pleasure with us; may they be rich in progeny here, many-formed, milking for Indra many dawns.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो यज्वने गृणते च शिक्षत उपेद्ददाति न स्वं मुषायति ।
भूयोभूयो रयिमिदस्य वर्धयन्न् अभिन्ने खिल्ये नि दधाति देवयुम् ॥
verses.rom:
indro yajvane grinate cha shikshata upeddadati na svam mushayati |
bhuyobhuyo rayimidasya vardhayann abhinne khilye ni dadhati devayum ||
verses.en: To the sacrificer and singer, to the helpful one (?), Indra verily gives further, steals not what is his; increasing more and more the wealth of him, he sets the godly man (devayú) in an undivided domain (? khilyá).

verses.sa:
न ता नशन्ति न दभाति तस्करो नासामामित्रो व्यथिरा दधर्षति ।
देवांश्च याभिर्यजते ददाति च ज्योगित्ताभिः सचते गोपतिः सह ॥
verses.rom:
na ta nashanti na dabhati taskaro nasamamitro vyathira dadharshati |
devamshcha yabhiryajate dadati cha jyogittabhih sachate gopatih saha ||
verses.en: They shall not be lost; no thief shall harm [them]; no hostile

verses.sa:
न ता अर्वा रेणुककाटोऽश्नुते न संस्कृतत्रमुप यन्ति ता अभि ।
उरुगायमभयं तस्य ता अनु गावो मर्तस्य वि चरन्ति यज्वनः ॥
verses.rom:
na ta arva renukakato'shnute na samskritatramupa yanti ta abhi |
urugayamabhayam tasya ta anu gavo martasya vi charanti yajvanah ||
verses.en: No dust-raising horseman (? árvan) reaches them; not unto the slaughter-house (?) do they go; those kine of that sacrificing mortal roam over wide-going fearlessness.

verses.sa:
गावो भगो गाव इन्द्रो म इच्छाद्गावः सोमस्य प्रथमस्य भक्षः ।
इमा या गावः स जनास इन्द्र इच्छामि हृदा मनसा चिदिन्द्रम् ॥
verses.rom:
gavo bhago gava indro ma ichchhadgavah somasya prathamasya bhakshah |
ima ya gavah sa janasa indra ichchhami hrida manasa chidindram ||
verses.en: The kine [are] Bhaga; Indra has seemed to me the kine; the kine [are] the draught of first soma; these kine—that, O people, [is] Indra; with whatever heart [and] mind I seek Indra.

verses.sa:
यूयं गावो मेदयथ कृशं चिदश्रीरं चित्कृणुथा सुप्रतीकम् ।
भद्रं गृहं कृणुथ भद्रवाचो बृहद्वो वय उच्यते सभासु ॥
verses.rom:
yuyam gavo medayatha krisham chidashriram chitkrinutha supratikam |
bhadram griham krinutha bhadravacho brihadvo vaya uchyate sabhasu ||
verses.en: Ye, O kine, fatten whoever is lean; the unlovely (açrīrá) one ye make of good aspect; ye make the house excellent, O ye of excellent voice; great is your vigor (váyas) called in the assemblies (sabhā́).

verses.sa:
प्रजावतीः सूयवसे रुशन्तीः शुद्धा अपः सुप्रपाणे पिबन्तीः ।
मा व स्तेन ईशत माघशंसः परि वो रुद्रस्य हेतिर्वृणक्तु ॥
verses.rom:
prajavatih suyavase rushantih shuddha apah suprapane pibantih |
ma va stena ishata maghashamsah pari vo rudrasya hetirvrinaktu ||
verses.en: Rich in progeny, shining in good pasture, drinking clear waters at a good watering-place—let not the thief master you, nor the evil-plotter; let Rudra's weapon avoid you.

verses.sa:
इममिन्द्र वर्धय क्षत्रियं मे इमं विशामेकवृषं कृणु त्वम् ।
निरमित्रान् अक्ष्णुह्यस्य सर्वांस्तान् रन्धयास्मा अहमुत्तरेषु ॥
verses.rom:
imamindra vardhaya kshatriyam me imam vishamekavrisham krinu tvam |
niramitran akshnuhyasya sarvamstan randhayasma ahamuttareshu ||
verses.en: Increase, O Indra, this Kshatriya for me; make thou this man sole chief of the clans (víç); unman (nis-akṣ) all his enemies; make them subject to him in the contests for preeminence.

verses.sa:
एमं भज ग्रामे अश्वेषु गोषु निष्टं भज यो अमित्रो अस्य ।
वर्ष्म क्षत्राणामयमस्तु राजेन्द्र शत्रुं रन्धय सर्वमस्मै ॥
verses.rom:
emam bhaja grame ashveshu goshu nishtam bhaja yo amitro asya |
varshma kshatranamayamastu rajendra shatrum randhaya sarvamasmai ||
verses.en: Portion thou this man in village, in horses, in kine; unportion that man who is his enemy; let this king be the summit of authorities (kṣatrá); O Indra, make every foe subject to him.

verses.sa:
अयमस्तु धनपतिर्धनानामयं विशां विश्पतिरस्तु राजा ।
अस्मिन्न् इन्द्र महि वर्चांसि धेह्यवर्चसं कृणुहि शत्रुमस्य ॥
verses.rom:
ayamastu dhanapatirdhananamayam visham vishpatirastu raja |
asminn indra mahi varchamsi dhehyavarchasam krinuhi shatrumasya ||
verses.en: Let this man be riches-lord of riches; let this king be people-lord of people; in him, O Indra, put great splendors; destitute of splendor make thou his foe.

verses.sa:
अस्मै द्यावापृथिवी भूरि वामं दुहाथां घर्मदुघे इव धेनू ।
अयं राजा प्रिय इन्द्रस्य भूयात्प्रियो गवामोषधीनां पशूनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
asmai dyavaprithivi bhuri vamam duhatham gharmadughe iva dhenu |
ayam raja priya indrasya bhuyatpriyo gavamoshadhinam pashunam ||
verses.en: For him, O heaven-and-earth, milk ye much that is pleasant (vāmá), like two milch kine that yield the hot-draught (gharmá-); may this king be dear to Indra, dear to kine, herbs, cattle.

verses.sa:
युनज्मि त उत्तरावन्तमिन्द्रं येन जयन्ति न पराजयन्ते ।
यस्त्वा करदेकवृषं जनानामुत राज्ञामुत्तमं मानवानाम् ॥
verses.rom:
yunajmi ta uttaravantamindram yena jayanti na parajayante |
yastva karadekavrisham jananamuta rajnamuttamam manavanam ||
verses.en: I join to thee Indra who gives superiority (? utttarā́vant), by whom men conquer, are not conquered; who shall make thee sole chief of people (jána), also uppermost of kings descended from Manu.

verses.sa:
उत्तरस्त्वमधरे ते सपत्ना ये के च राजन् प्रतिशत्रवस्ते ।
एकवृष इन्द्रसखा जिगीवां छत्रूयतामा भरा भोजनानि ॥
verses.rom:
uttarastvamadhare te sapatna ye ke cha rajan pratishatravaste |
ekavrisha indrasakha jigivam chhatruyatama bhara bhojanani ||
verses.en: Superior [art] thou, inferior thy rivals, whosoever, O king, are thine opposing foes; sole chief, having Indra as companion, having conquered, bring thou in the enjoyments (bhójana) of them that play the foe.

verses.sa:
सिंहप्रतीको विशो अद्धि सर्वा व्याघ्रप्रतीकोऽव बाधस्व शत्रून् ।
एकवृष इन्द्रसखा जिगीवां छत्रूयतामा खिदा भोजनानि ॥
verses.rom:
simhapratiko visho addhi sarva vyaghrapratiko'va badhasva shatrun |
ekavrisha indrasakha jigivam chhatruyatama khida bhojanani ||
verses.en: Of lion-aspect, do thou devour (ad) all the clans (viç); of tiger-aspect, do thou beat down the foes; sole chief, having Indra as companion, having conquered, seize thou on (ā-khid) the enjoyments of them that play the foe.

verses.sa:
अग्नेर्मन्वे प्रथमस्य प्रचेतसः पाञ्चजन्यस्य बहुधा यमिन्धते ।
विशोविशः प्रविशिवांसमीमहे स नो मुञ्चत्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
agnermanve prathamasya prachetasah panchajanyasya bahudha yamindhate |
vishovishah pravishivamsamimahe sa no munchatvamhasah ||
verses.en: I reverence (man-u) first the forethoughtful (prácetas) Agni, him of the five peoples, whom men kindle in many places; we pray to him who hath entered (pra-viç) into clans after clans (víç): let him free us from distress.

verses.sa:
यथा हव्यं वहसि जातवेदो यथा यज्ञं कल्पयसि प्रजानन् ।
एवा देवेभ्यः सुमतिं न आ वह स नो मुञ्चत्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
yatha havyam vahasi jatavedo yatha yajnam kalpayasi prajanan |
eva devebhyah sumatim na a vaha sa no munchatvamhasah ||
verses.en: As thou carriest the oblation, O Jātavedas; as, foreknowing, thou adaptest the sacrifice—so do thou convey to us favor from the gods: let him free us from distress.

verses.sa:
यामन्यामन्न् उपयुक्तं वहिष्ठं कर्मङ्कर्मन्न् आभगमग्निमीडे ।
रक्षोहणं यज्ञवृधं घृताहुतं स नो मुञ्चत्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
yamanyamann upayuktam vahishtham karmankarmann abhagamagnimide |
rakshohanam yajnavridham ghritahutam sa no munchatvamhasah ||
verses.en: Put to service at every course (yā́man), best carrier, sharer (ā́bhaga) at every rite, Agni I praise, demon-slayer, sacrifice-increaser, offered to with ghee: let him free us from distress.

verses.sa:
सुजातं जातवेदसमग्निं वैश्वानरं विभुम् ।
हव्यवाहं हवामहे स नो मुञ्चत्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
sujatam jatavedasamagnim vaishvanaram vibhum |
havyavaham havamahe sa no munchatvamhasah ||
verses.en: The well-born Jātavedas, the mighty (vibhú) Agni belonging to all men (vāiçvānará), the carrier of oblations, we call on: let him free us from distress.

verses.sa:
येन ऋषयो बलमद्योतयन् युजा येनासुराणामयुवन्त मायाः ।
येनाग्निना पणीन् इन्द्रो जिगाय स नो मुञ्चत्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
yena rishayo balamadyotayan yuja yenasuranamayuvanta mayah |
yenagnina panin indro jigaya sa no munchatvamhasah ||
verses.en: With whom as ally the seers made [their] strength shine out; with whom they repelled the wiles of the Asuras; with whom, Agni, Indra conquered the Paṇis—let him free us from distress.

verses.sa:
येन देवा अमृतमन्वविन्दन् येनौषधीर्मधुमतीरकृण्वन् ।
येन देवाः स्वराभरन्त्स नो मुञ्चत्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
yena deva amritamanvavindan yenaushadhirmadhumatirakrinvan |
yena devah svarabharantsa no munchatvamhasah ||
verses.en: By whom the gods discovered the immortal; by whom they made the herbs rich in honey; by whom the gods brought the heaven (svàr)—let him free us from distress.

verses.sa:
यस्येदं प्रदिशि यद्विरोचते यज्जातं जनितव्यं च केवलम् ।
स्तौम्यग्निं नाथितो जोहवीमि स नो मुञ्चत्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
yasyedam pradishi yadvirochate yajjatam janitavyam cha kevalam |
staumyagnim nathito johavimi sa no munchatvamhasah ||
verses.en: In whose direction [is] whatever shines forth (vi-ruc) here, what is born and to be born, all of it—I praise Agni, [as a] suppliant I call loudly on [him]—let him free us from distress.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य मन्महे शश्वदिदस्य मन्महे वृत्रघ्न स्तोमा उप मेम आगुः ।
यो दाशुषः सुकृतो हवमेति स नो मुञ्चत्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
indrasya manmahe shashvadidasya manmahe vritraghna stoma upa mema aguh |
yo dashushah sukrito havameti sa no munchatvamhasah ||
verses.en: We reverence Indra; constantly do we reverence him; these praise-hymns (stoma) of the Vṛtra-slayer have come unto me; he who goes to the call of the worshiper (dāçvā́ṅs), of the well-doer—let him free us from distress.

verses.sa:
य उग्रीणामुग्रबाहुर्ययुर्यो दानवानां बलमारुरोज ।
येन जिताः सिन्धवो येन गावः स नो मुञ्चत्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
ya ugrinamugrabahuryayuryo danavanam balamaruroja |
yena jitah sindhavo yena gavah sa no munchatvamhasah ||
verses.en: He who, having formidable arms, is repeller (? yayú) of the formidable ones (f.); who battered the strength of the Dānavas; by whom are conquered the rivers, by whom the kine—let him free us from distress.

verses.sa:
यश्चर्षणिप्रो वृषभः स्वर्विद्यस्मै ग्रावाणः प्रवदन्ति नृम्णम् ।
यस्याध्वरः सप्तहोता मदिष्ठः स नो मुञ्चत्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
yashcharshanipro vrishabhah svarvidyasmai gravanah pravadanti nrimnam |
yasyadhvarah saptahota madishthah sa no munchatvamhasah ||
verses.en: He who is filler of people (carṣaṇí-), bull, heaven-finder (svarvíd); for whom the pressing-stones proclaim [his] manliness; whose is the sacrifice with seven priests, most intoxicating—let him free us from distress.

verses.sa:
यस्य वशास ऋषभास उक्षणो यस्मै मीयन्ते स्वरवः स्वर्विदे ।
यस्मै शुक्रः पवते ब्रह्मशुम्भितः स नो मुञ्चत्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
yasya vashasa rishabhasa ukshano yasmai miyante svaravah svarvide |
yasmai shukrah pavate brahmashumbhitah sa no munchatvamhasah ||
verses.en: Whose are cows (vaçā́), bulls, oxen; for whom, the heaven-finder, sacrificial posts (sváru) are set up; for whom the bright (çukrá) [soma] purifies itself, adorned with sacred words (bráhma-)—let him free us from distress.

verses.sa:
यस्य जुष्टिं सोमिनः कामयन्ते यं हवन्त इषुमन्तं गविष्टौ ।
यस्मिन्न् अर्कः शिश्रिये यस्मिन्न् ओजः स नो मुञ्चत्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
yasya jushtim sominah kamayante yam havanta ishumantam gavishtau |
yasminn arkah shishriye yasminn ojah sa no munchatvamhasah ||
verses.en: He whose enjoyment (júṣṭi) the offerers of soma desire; whom, possessed of arrows, men call on in the cattle-raid (gáviṣṭi); on whom depends song (? arká), on whom force—let him free us from distress.

verses.sa:
यः प्रथमः कर्मकृत्याय जज्ञे यस्य वीर्यं प्रथमस्यानुबुद्धम् ।
येनोद्यतो वज्रोऽभ्यायताहिं स नो मुञ्चत्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
yah prathamah karmakrityaya jajne yasya viryam prathamasyanubuddham |
yenodyato vajro'bhyayatahim sa no munchatvamhasah ||
verses.en: He who was born first for the doing of deeds; of whom first the heroism was noted; by whom brandished (ud-yam) the thunderbolt went at (abhi-i) the dragon—let him free us from distress.

verses.sa:
यः संग्रामान् नयति सं युधे वशी यः पुष्टानि संसृजति द्वयानि ।
स्तौमीन्द्रं नाथितो जोहवीमि स नो मुञ्चत्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
yah samgraman nayati sam yudhe vashi yah pushtani samsrijati dvayani |
staumindram nathito johavimi sa no munchatvamhasah ||
verses.en: He who, controlling, leads together hosts (saṁgrāmá) for fighting; who mingles (sam-sṛj) the possessions (puṣṭá) of the two parties—I

verses.sa:
वायोः सवितुर्विदथानि मन्महे यावात्मन्वद्विशथो यौ च रक्षथः ।
यौ विश्वस्य परिभू बभूवथुस्तौ नो मुञ्चतमंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
vayoh saviturvidathani manmahe yavatmanvadvishatho yau cha rakshathah |
yau vishvasya paribhu babhuvathustau no munchatamamhasah ||
verses.en: Of Vāyu, of Savitar we reverence the counsels (vidátha): ye who enter and who defend what has life (ātmanvánt); ye who have become encompassers of the all—do ye free us from distress.

verses.sa:
ययोः संख्याता वरिमा पार्हिवानि याभ्यां रजो युपितमन्तरिक्षे ।
ययोः प्रायं नान्वानशे कश्चन तौ नो मुञ्चतमंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
yayoh samkhyata varima parhivani yabhyam rajo yupitamantarikshe |
yayoh prayam nanvanashe kashchana tau no munchatamamhasah ||
verses.en: Of whom are numbered the widths of the earth; by whom the welkin (rájas) is made fast (yup) in the atmosphere; whose progress no one soever has reached (anu-aç)—do ye free us from distress.

verses.sa:
तव व्रते नि विशन्ते जनासस्त्वय्युदिते प्रेरते चित्रभानो ।
युवं वायो सविता च भुवनानि रक्षथस्तौ नो मुञ्चतमंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
tava vrate ni vishante janasastvayyudite prerate chitrabhano |
yuvam vayo savita cha bhuvanani rakshathastau no munchatamamhasah ||
verses.en: In [conformity with] thy course (vratá) people (jána) go to rest; when thou art risen, they go forth, O thou of beauteous luster; ye, O Vāyu and Savitar, defend beings—do ye free us from distress.
