verses.sa:
अपेतो वायो सविता च दुष्कृतमप रक्षांसि शिमिदां च सेधतम् ।
सं ह्यूर्जया सृजथः सं बलेन तौ नो मुञ्चतमंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
apeto vayo savita cha dushkritamapa rakshamsi shimidam cha sedhatam |
sam hyurjaya srijathah sam balena tau no munchatamamhasah ||
verses.en: Away from here, O Vāyu and Savitar, drive (sidh) ye what is ill-done, away the demons and Çimidā; for ye unite (sam-sṛj) [men] with refreshment (ūrjā́), with strength—do ye free us from distress.

verses.sa:
रयिं मे पोषं सवितोत वायुस्तनू दक्षमा सुवतां सुशेवम् ।
अयक्ष्मतातिं मह इह धत्तं तौ नो मुञ्चतमंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
rayim me posham savitota vayustanu dakshama suvatam sushevam |
ayakshmatatim maha iha dhattam tau no munchatamamhasah ||
verses.en: Let Savitar and Vāyu engender (ā-sū) in my body (tanū́) wealth, prosperity, very propitious dexterity; do ye put here freedom from yákṣma, greatness; do ye free us from distress.

verses.sa:
प्र सुमतिं सवितर्वाय ऊतये महस्वन्तं मत्सरं मादयाथः ।
अर्वाग्वामस्य प्रवतो नि यच्छतं तौ नो मुञ्चतमंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
pra sumatim savitarvaya utaye mahasvantam matsaram madayathah |
arvagvamasya pravato ni yachchhatam tau no munchatamamhasah ||
verses.en: O Savitar, Vāyu, [give] forth favor in order to aid; ye cause to revel in the intoxicating jovial [soma]; hitherward from the height (pravát) confirm ye of what is pleasant (vāmá); do ye free us from distress.

verses.sa:
उप श्रेष्ठा न आशिषो देवयोर्धामन्न् अस्थिरन् ।
स्तौमि देवं सवितारं च वायुं तौ नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
upa shreshtha na ashisho devayordhamann asthiran |
staumi devam savitaram cha vayum tau no munchantvamhasah ||
verses.en: The best blessings (āçís) have come unto us in the domain (dhā́man) of the two gods; I praise god Savitar and Vāyu: do ye free us from distress.

verses.sa:
मन्वे वां द्यावापृथिवी सुभोजसौ सचेतसौ ये अप्रथेथाममिता योजनानि ।
प्रतिष्ठे ह्यभवतं वसूनां ते नो मुञ्चतमंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
manve vam dyavaprithivi subhojasau sachetasau ye aprathethamamita yojanani |
pratishthe hyabhavatam vasunam te no munchatamamhasah ||
verses.en: I reverence you, O heaven-and-earth, ye well-nourishing ones (subhójas), who, like-minded (sácetas) did spread out unmeasured intervals (yójana); since ye became foundations (pratiṣṭhā́) of good things, do ye free us from distress.

verses.sa:
प्रतिष्ठे ह्यभवतं वसूनां प्रवृद्धे देवी सुभगे उरूची ।
द्यावापृथिवी भवतं मे स्योने ते नो मुञ्चतमंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
pratishthe hyabhavatam vasunam pravriddhe devi subhage uruchi |
dyavaprithivi bhavatam me syone te no munchatamamhasah ||
verses.en: Since ye became foundations of good things, ye much increased, divine, fortunate, wide-extended ones, O heaven-and-earth, be pleasant to me: do ye free us from distress.

verses.sa:
असन्तापे सुतपसौ हुवेऽहमुर्वी गम्भीरे कविभिर्नमस्ये ।
द्यावापृथिवी भवतं मे स्योने ते नो मुञ्चतमंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
asantape sutapasau huve'hamurvi gambhire kavibhirnamasye |
dyavaprithivi bhavatam me syone te no munchatamamhasah ||
verses.en: I call upon the not-distressing, of excellent penance, wide, profound, to be reverenced by poets: O heaven- etc. etc.

verses.sa:
ये अमृतं बिभृथो ये हवींषि ये स्रोत्या बिभृथो ये मनुष्यान् ।
द्यावापृथिवी भवतं मे स्योने ते नो मुञ्चतमंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
ye amritam bibhritho ye havimshi ye srotya bibhritho ye manushyan |
dyavaprithivi bhavatam me syone te no munchatamamhasah ||
verses.en: Ye who bear the immortal (amṛ́ta), who the oblations; who bear the streams (srotyā́), who human beings (manuṣyà): O heaven- etc. etc.

verses.sa:
ये उस्रिया बिभृथो ये वनस्पतीन् ययोर्वां विश्वा भुवनान्यन्तः ।
द्यावापृथिवी भवतं मे स्योने ते नो मुञ्चतमंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
ye usriya bibhritho ye vanaspatin yayorvam vishva bhuvananyantah |
dyavaprithivi bhavatam me syone te no munchatamamhasah ||
verses.en: Ye who bear the ruddy [kine], who the forest-trees; ye within whom [are] all beings: O heaven- etc. etc.

verses.sa:
ये कीलालेन तर्पयथो ये घृतेन याभ्यामृते न किं चन शक्नुवन्ति ।
द्यावापृथिवी भवतं मे स्योने ते नो मुञ्चतमंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
ye kilalena tarpayatho ye ghritena yabhyamrite na kim chana shaknuvanti |
dyavaprithivi bhavatam me syone te no munchatamamhasah ||
verses.en: Ye who gratify with sweet drink (kīlā́la), who with ghee; without whom [men] can [do] nothing whatever: O heaven- etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यन् मेदमभिशोचति येनयेन वा कृतं पौरुषेयान् न दैवात्।
स्तौमि द्यावापृथिवी नाथितो जोहवीमि ते नो मुञ्चतमंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
yan medamabhishochati yenayena va kritam paurusheyan na daivat|
staumi dyavaprithivi nathito johavimi te no munchatamamhasah ||
verses.en: This that scorches (abhi-çuc) me, or by whomsoever done, from what is human, not divine—I praise heaven-and-earth, [as] a suppliant I call loudly on [them]: do ye free us from distress.

verses.sa:
मरुतां मन्वे अधि मे ब्रुवन्तु प्रेमं वाजं वाजसाते अवन्तु ।
आशून् इव सुयमान् अह्व ऊतये ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
marutam manve adhi me bruvantu premam vajam vajasate avantu |
ashun iva suyaman ahva utaye te no munchantvamhasah ||
verses.en: The Maruts I reverence; let them bless me; let them favor this steed (? vā́ja) in the race (? vā́jasāta); I have called on them for aid, like easily-controlled swift [horses]: let them free us from distress.

verses.sa:
उत्समक्षितं व्यचन्ति ये सदा य आसिञ्चन्ति रसमोषधीषु ।
पुरो दधे मरुतः पृश्निमातॄंस्ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
utsamakshitam vyachanti ye sada ya asinchanti rasamoshadhishu |
puro dadhe marutah prishnimatrimste no munchantvamhasah ||
verses.en: Who always open (vi-ac) an unexhausted fountain; who pour in sap into the herbs—I put forward the Maruts, sons of the spotted one: let them free us from distress.

verses.sa:
पयो धेनूनां रसमोषधीनां जवमर्वतां कवयो य इन्वथ ।
शग्मा भवन्तु मरुतो नः स्योनास्ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
payo dhenunam rasamoshadhinam javamarvatam kavayo ya invatha |
shagma bhavantu maruto nah syonaste no munchantvamhasah ||
verses.en: Ye, O poets, that send the milk of the kine, the sap of the herbs, the speed of the coursers—let the helpful (? çagmá) Maruts be pleasant to us; let them free us from distress.

verses.sa:
अपः समुद्राद्दिवमुद्वहन्ति दिवस्पृथिवीमभि ये सृजन्ति ।
ये अद्भिरीशाना मरुतश्चरन्ति ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
apah samudraddivamudvahanti divasprithivimabhi ye srijanti |
ye adbhirishana marutashcharanti te no munchantvamhasah ||
verses.en: Waters from the ocean to the sky they carry up, they who pour [them] from the sky upon the earth—the Maruts who go about lording it with the waters: let them free us from distress.

verses.sa:
ये कीलालेन तर्पयन्ति ये घृतेन ये वा वयो मेदसा संसृजन्ति ।
ये अद्भिरीशाना मरुतो वर्षयन्ति ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
ye kilalena tarpayanti ye ghritena ye va vayo medasa samsrijanti |
ye adbhirishana maruto varshayanti te no munchantvamhasah ||
verses.en: They who gratify with sweet drink, who with ghee; or who combine (sam-sṛj) vigor (váyas) with fatness; the Maruts who, lording it with the waters, cause to rain: let them free us from distress.

verses.sa:
यदीदिदं मरुतो मारुतेन यदि देवा दैव्येनेदृगार ।
यूयमीशिध्वे वसवस्तस्य निष्कृतेस्ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
yadididam maruto marutena yadi deva daivyenedrigara |
yuyamishidhve vasavastasya nishkriteste no munchantvamhasah ||
verses.en: If now indeed, O Maruts, by what relates to the Maruts—if, O gods, by what relates to the gods, I have fallen into such a plight: ye, O Vasus, are masters (īç) of the removal of that: let them free us from distress.

verses.sa:
तिग्ममनीकं विदितं सहस्वन् मारुतं शर्धः पृतनासूग्रम् ।
स्तौमि मरुतो नाथितो जोहवीमि ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
tigmamanikam viditam sahasvan marutam shardhah pritanasugram |
staumi maruto nathito johavimi te no munchantvamhasah ||
verses.en: A sharp front, known [as] powerful, [is] the troop (çárdhas) of Maruts, formidable in fights; I praise the Maruts, [as] a suppliant I call loudly on [them]: let them free us from distress.

verses.sa:
भवाशर्वौ मन्वे वां तस्य वित्तं ययोर्वामिदं प्रदिशि यद्विरोचते ।
यावस्येशाथे द्विपदो यौ चतुष्पदस्तौ नो मुञ्चतमंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
bhavasharvau manve vam tasya vittam yayorvamidam pradishi yadvirochate |
yavasyeshathe dvipado yau chatushpadastau no munchatamamhasah ||
verses.en: O Bhava-and-Çarva, I reverence you, know ye that; ye in whose direction is all that shines out (vi-ruc) here, who lord it over these bipeds [and] quadrupeds: do ye free us from distress.

verses.sa:
ययोरभ्यभ्व उत यद्दूरे चिद्यौ विदिताविषुभृतामसिष्ठौ ।
यावस्येशथे द्विपदो यौ चतुष्पदस्तौ नो मुञ्चतमंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
yayorabhyabhva uta yaddure chidyau viditavishubhritamasishthau |
yavasyeshathe dvipado yau chatushpadastau no munchatamamhasah ||
verses.en: Ye whose is whatever is on the way and afar; who are known as best shooters among arrow-bearers; who lord it etc. etc.

verses.sa:
सहस्राक्षौ वृत्रहना हुवेहं दूरेगव्यूती स्तुवन्न् एम्युग्रौ ।
यावस्येशथे द्विपदो यौ चतुष्पदस्तौ नो मुञ्चतमंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
sahasrakshau vritrahana huveham duregavyuti stuvann emyugrau |
yavasyeshathe dvipado yau chatushpadastau no munchatamamhasah ||
verses.en: I call on the (two) thousand-eyed Vṛtra-slayers; I go praising the (two) formidable ones, having pastures afar: who lord it etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यावारेभाथे बहु साकमग्रे प्र चेदस्राष्ट्रमभिभां जनेषु ।
यावस्येशथे द्विपदो यौ चतुष्पदस्तौ नो मुञ्चतमंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
yavarebhathe bahu sakamagre pra chedasrashtramabhibham janeshu |
yavasyeshathe dvipado yau chatushpadastau no munchatamamhasah ||
verses.en: Ye who have taken hold (ā-rabh) of much together in the beginning, if ye have let loose (pra-sṛj) the portent (abhibhā́) among the people (jána): who lord it etc. etc.

verses.sa:
ययोर्वधान् नापपद्यते कश्चनान्तर्देवेषूत मानुषेषु ।
यावस्येशथे द्विपदो यौ चतुष्पदस्तौ नो मुञ्चतमंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
yayorvadhan napapadyate kashchanantardeveshuta manusheshu |
yavasyeshathe dvipado yau chatushpadastau no munchatamamhasah ||
verses.en: From whose deadly weapon no one soever escapes (apa-pad), among gods and among men (mā́nuṣa); who lord it etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यः कृत्याकृन् मूलकृद्यातुधानो नि तस्मिन् धत्तं वज्रमुग्रौ ।
यावस्येशथे द्विपदो यौ चतुष्पदस्तौ नो मुञ्चतमंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
yah krityakrin mulakridyatudhano ni tasmin dhattam vajramugrau |
yavasyeshathe dvipado yau chatushpadastau no munchatamamhasah ||
verses.en: Whoso is witchcraft-maker, root-cutter (?), sorcerer, down on him put [your] thunderbolt, O formidable ones; who lord it etc. etc.

verses.sa:
अधि नो ब्रूतं पृतनासूग्रौ सं वज्रेण सृजतं यः किमीदी ।
स्तौमि भवाशर्वौ नाथितो जोहवीमि तौ नो मुञ्चतमंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
adhi no brutam pritanasugrau sam vajrena srijatam yah kimidi |
staumi bhavasharvau nathito johavimi tau no munchatamamhasah ||
verses.en: Bless us in fights, O formidable ones; visit (sam-sṛj) with [your] thunderbolt whoever is a kimīdín: I praise Bhava-and-Çarva; [as] a suppliant I call loudly on [them]; do ye free us from distress.

verses.sa:
मन्वे वां मित्रावरुणावृतावृधौ सचेतसौ द्रुह्वणो यौ नुदेथे ।
प्र सत्यावानमवथो भरेषु तौ नो मुञ्चतमंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
manve vam mitravarunavritavridhau sachetasau druhvano yau nudethe |
pra satyavanamavatho bhareshu tau no munchatamamhasah ||
verses.en: I reverence you, O Mitra-and-Varuṇa, increasers of right; who, accordant, thrust [away] the malicious (drúhvan); [who] favor the truthful one in conflicts (bhára): do ye free us from distress.

verses.sa:
सचेतसौ द्रुह्वणो यौ नुदेथे प्र सत्यावानमवथो भरेषु ।
यौ गच्छथो नृचक्षसौ बभ्रुणा सुतं तौ नो मुञ्चतमंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
sachetasau druhvano yau nudethe pra satyavanamavatho bhareshu |
yau gachchhatho nrichakshasau babhruna sutam tau no munchatamamhasah ||
verses.en: Ye who, accordant, thrust [away] the malicious; [who] favor the truthful one in conflicts; who, men-watching, go unto the brown soma—do ye free us from distress.

verses.sa:
यावङ्गिरसमवथो यावगस्तिं मित्रावरुणा जमदग्निमत्त्रिम् ।
यौ कश्यपमवथो यौ वसिष्ठं तौ नो मुञ्चतमंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
yavangirasamavatho yavagastim mitravaruna jamadagnimattrim |
yau kashyapamavatho yau vasishtham tau no munchatamamhasah ||
verses.en: Ye who favor An̄giras, who Agasti, Jamadagni, Atri, O Mitra-and-Varuṇa, who favor Kaçyapa, who Vasishṭha—do ye free us from distress.

verses.sa:
यौ श्यावाश्वमवथो वाध्र्यश्वं मित्रावरुणा पुरुमीढमत्त्रिम् ।
यौ विमदमवथो सप्तवध्रिं तौ नो मुञ्चतमंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
yau shyavashvamavatho vadhryashvam mitravaruna purumidhamattrim |
yau vimadamavatho saptavadhrim tau no munchatamamhasah ||
verses.en: Ye who favor Çyāvāçva, Vadhryaçva, Purumīḍha, Atri, O Mitra-and-Varuṇa, who favor Vimada, Saptavadhri—do ye free us from distress.

verses.sa:
यौ भरद्वाजमवथो यौ गविष्ठिरं विश्वामित्रं वरुण मित्र कुत्सम् ।
यौ कक्षीवन्तमवथो प्रोत कण्वं तौ नो मुञ्चतमंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
yau bharadvajamavatho yau gavishthiram vishvamitram varuna mitra kutsam |
yau kakshivantamavatho prota kanvam tau no munchatamamhasah ||
verses.en: Ye who favor Bharadvāja, who Gavishṭhira, Viçvāmitra, Kutsa, O Varuṇa [and] Mitra; who favor Kakshīvant, also Kaṇva—do ye free us from distress.

verses.sa:
यौ मेधातिथिमवथो यौ त्रिशोकं मित्रावरुणावुशनां काव्यं यौ ।
यौ गोतममवथो प्रोत मुग्दलं तौ नो मुञ्चतमंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
yau medhatithimavatho yau trishokam mitravarunavushanam kavyam yau |
yau gotamamavatho prota mugdalam tau no munchatamamhasah ||
verses.en: Ye who favor Medhātithi, who Triçoka, who Uçanas Kāvya, O Mitra-and-Varuṇa; who favor Gotama, also Mudgala—do ye free us from distress.

verses.sa:
ययो रथः सत्यवर्त्म र्जुरश्मिर्मिथुया चरन्तमभियाति दूषयन् ।
स्तौमि मित्रावरुणौ नाथितो जोहवीमि तौ नो मुञ्चतमंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
yayo rathah satyavartma rjurashmirmithuya charantamabhiyati dushayan |
staumi mitravarunau nathito johavimi tau no munchatamamhasah ||
verses.en: Whose chariot, of true track, of straight reins, goes spoiling against him who behaves (car) falsely—I praise Mitra-and-Varuṇa; [as] a suppliant I call loudly on [them]: do ye free us from distress.

verses.sa:
अहं रुद्रेभिर्वसुभिश्चराम्यहमादित्यैरुत विश्वदेवैः ।
अहं मित्रावरुणोभा बिभर्म्यहमिन्द्राग्नी अहमश्विनोभा ॥
verses.rom:
aham rudrebhirvasubhishcharamyahamadityairuta vishvadevaih |
aham mitravarunobha bibharmyahamindragni ahamashvinobha ||
verses.en: I go about with the Rudras, the Vasus, I with the Ādityas and the All-gods; I bear Mitra-and-Varuṇa both, I Indra-and-Agni, I both Açvins.

verses.sa:
अहं राष्ट्री संगमनी वसूनां चिकितुषी प्रथमा यज्ञियानाम् ।
तां मा देवा व्यदधुः पुरुत्रा भूरिस्थात्रां भूर्यावेशयन्तः ॥
verses.rom:
aham rashtri samgamani vasunam chikitushi prathama yajniyanam |
tam ma deva vyadadhuh purutra bhuristhatram bhuryaveshayantah ||
verses.en: I am queen, gatherer of good things, the first that has understood the matters of sacrifice; me here the gods distributed manifoldly, making me of many stations enter into many.

verses.sa:
अहमेव स्वयमिदं वदामि जुष्टं देवानामुत मानुषाणाम् ।
यं कामये तन्तमुग्रं कृणोमि तं ब्रह्माणं तमृषिं तं सुमेधाम् ॥
verses.rom:
ahameva svayamidam vadami jushtam devanamuta manushanam |
yam kamaye tantamugram krinomi tam brahmanam tamrishim tam sumedham ||
verses.en: I my own self say this, [which is] enjoyable of gods and of men; whomsoever I desire, him I make formidable, him priest (brahmán), him seer, him very wise.

verses.sa:
मया सोऽन्नमत्ति यो विपश्यति यः प्राणति य ईं शृणोत्युक्तम् ।
अमन्तवो मां त उप क्षियन्ति श्रुधि श्रुत श्रुद्धेयं ते वदामि ॥
verses.rom:
maya so'nnamatti yo vipashyati yah pranati ya im shrinotyuktam |
amantavo mam ta upa kshiyanti shrudhi shruta shruddheyam te vadami ||
verses.en: By me doth he eat food who looks abroad, who breathes, who indeed hears what is spoken; unknowing (? amantú) they dwell upon me; hear thou, heard-of one; I say to thee what is to be credited.

verses.sa:
अहं रुद्राय धनुरा तनोमि ब्रह्मद्विषे शरवे हन्तवा उ ।
अहं जनाय समदं कृणोमि अहं द्यावापृथिवी आ विवेश ॥
verses.rom:
aham rudraya dhanura tanomi brahmadvishe sharave hantava u |
aham janaya samadam krinomi aham dyavaprithivi a vivesha ||
verses.en: I stretch the bow for Rudra, for his shaft to slay the bráhman-hater; I make strife (samád) for the people (jána); into heaven-and-earth have I entered.

verses.sa:
अहं सोममाहनसं बिभर्म्यहं त्वष्टारमुत पूषणं भगम् ।
अहं दधामि द्रविणा हविष्मते सुप्राव्या यजमानाय सुन्वते ॥
verses.rom:
aham somamahanasam bibharmyaham tvashtaramuta pushanam bhagam |
aham dadhami dravina havishmate supravya yajamanaya sunvate ||
verses.en: I bear the heady (? āhanás) soma, I Tvashṭar, also Pūshan, Bhaga; I assign property to the giver of oblations, to the very zealous (?), the sacrificer, the presser of soma.

verses.sa:
अहं सुवे पितरमस्य मूर्धन् मम योनिरप्स्वन्तः समुद्रे ।
ततो वि तिष्ठे भुवनानि विश्वोतामूं द्यां वर्ष्मणोप स्पृशामि ॥
verses.rom:
aham suve pitaramasya murdhan mama yonirapsvantah samudre |
tato vi tishthe bhuvanani vishvotamum dyam varshmanopa sprishami ||
verses.en: I quicken (give birth to?) the father in its (his?) head; my womb (yóni) is within the waters, the ocean; thence I extend myself (vi-sthā) to all beings; even yon sky I touch with my summit.

verses.sa:
अहमेव वातैव प्र वाम्यारभमाणा भुवनानि विश्वा ।
परो दिवा पर एना पृथिव्यैतावती महिम्ना सं बभूव ॥
verses.rom:
ahameva vataiva pra vamyarabhamana bhuvanani vishva |
paro diva para ena prithivyaitavati mahimna sam babhuva ||
verses.en: I myself blow forth like the wind, taking hold upon all beings; beyond the sky, beyond the earth here—such have I become by greatness.

verses.sa:
त्वया मन्यो सरथमारुजन्तो हर्षमाणा हृषितासो मरुत्वन् ।
तिग्मेषव आयुधा संशिशाना उप प्र यन्तु नरो अग्निरूपाः ॥
verses.rom:
tvaya manyo sarathamarujanto harshamana hrishitaso marutvan |
tigmeshava ayudha samshishana upa pra yantu naro agnirupah ||
verses.en: In alliance (sarátham) with thee, O fury, battering, feeling excitement, excited, O companion of the Maruts, having keen arrows, sharpening up their weapons, let [our] men go forward unto [the foe], having forms of fire.

verses.sa:
अग्निरिव मन्यो त्विषितः सहस्व सेनानीर्नः सहुरे हूत एधि ।
हत्वाय शत्रून् वि भजस्व वेद ओजो मिमानो वि मृधो नुदस्व ॥
verses.rom:
agniriva manyo tvishitah sahasva senanirnah sahure huta edhi |
hatvaya shatrun vi bhajasva veda ojo mimano vi mridho nudasva ||
verses.en: Like fire, O fury, do thou, made brilliant, overpower; invoked, O powerful one, do thou be our army-leader; having slain the foes, share out their possession (védas); making (mā) force, thrust away the scorners (mṛ́dh).

verses.sa:
सहस्व मन्यो अभिमातिमस्मै रुजन् मृणन् प्रमृणन् प्रेहि शत्रून् ।
उग्रं ते पाजो नन्वा रुरुध्रे वशी वशं नयासा एकज त्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
sahasva manyo abhimatimasmai rujan mrinan pramrinan prehi shatrun |
ugram te pajo nanva rurudhre vashi vasham nayasa ekaja tvam ||
verses.en: Overpower for us (?), O fury, the hostile plotter; go forward breaking, killing, slaughtering the foes; thy formidable rush (? pā́jas) surely they have not impeded; thou, controlling, shalt bring them under control, O sole-born one.

verses.sa:
एको बहूनामसि मन्य ईडिता विशंविशं युद्धाय सं शिशाधि ।
अकृत्तरुक्त्वया युजा वयं द्युमन्तं घोषं विजयाय कृण्मसि ॥
verses.rom:
eko bahunamasi manya idita vishamvisham yuddhaya sam shishadhi |
akrittaruktvaya yuja vayam dyumantam ghosham vijayaya krinmasi ||
verses.en: Thou art the one praised (?) of many, O fury; sharpen up clan on clan (víç) unto fighting; with thee as ally (yuj), O thou of undivided brightness (?), we make a clear noise unto victory.

verses.sa:
विजेषकृदिन्द्र इवानवब्रवोऽस्माकं मन्यो अधिपा भवेह ।
प्रियं ते नाम सहुरे गृणीमसि विद्मा तमुत्सं यत आबभूथ ॥
verses.rom:
vijeshakridindra ivanavabravo'smakam manyo adhipa bhaveha |
priyam te nama sahure grinimasi vidma tamutsam yata ababhutha ||
verses.en: Victory-making, like Indra, not to be talked down, do thou, O fury, be our over-lord here; thy dear name we sing, O powerful one; we know that fount whence thou camest (ā-bhū).

verses.sa:
आभूत्या सहजा वज्र सायक सहो बिभर्षि सहभूत उत्तरम् ।
क्रत्वा नो मन्यो सह मेद्येधि महाधनस्य पुरुहूत संसृजि ॥
verses.rom:
abhutya sahaja vajra sayaka saho bibharshi sahabhuta uttaram |
kratva no manyo saha medyedhi mahadhanasya puruhuta samsriji ||
verses.en: Born together with efficacy (? ā́bhūti), O missile (sā́yaka) thunderbolt, thou bearest superior power, O associate; be thou allied (medín) with our energy (krátu), O fury, much-invoked one, in the mingling (saṁsṛ́j) of great riches.

verses.sa:
संसृष्टं धनमुभयं समाकृतमस्मभ्यं धत्तां वरुणश्च मन्युः ।
भियो दधाना हृदयेषु शत्रवः पराजितासो अप नि लयन्ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
samsrishtam dhanamubhayam samakritamasmabhyam dhattam varunashcha manyuh |
bhiyo dadhana hridayeshu shatravah parajitaso apa ni layantam ||
verses.en: The mingled riches of both sides, put together, let Varuṇa and fury assign to us; conceiving fears in their hearts, let the foes, conquered, vanish away.

verses.sa:
यस्ते मन्योऽविधद्वज्र सायक सह ओजः पुष्यति विश्वमानुषक्।
साह्याम दासमार्यं त्वया युजा वयं सहस्कृतेन सहसा सहस्वता ॥
verses.rom:
yaste manyo'vidhadvajra sayaka saha ojah pushyati vishvamanushak|
sahyama dasamaryam tvaya yuja vayam sahaskritena sahasa sahasvata ||
verses.en: He who hath worshiped thee, O fury, missile thunderbolt, gains (puṣ) power, force, everything, in succession; may we, with thee as ally, that art made of power, overpower the barbarian, the Aryan, with powerful power.

verses.sa:
मन्युरिन्द्रो मन्युरेवास देवो मन्युर्होता वरुणो जातवेदाः ।
मन्युं विश ईडते मानुषीर्याः पहि नो मन्यो तपसा सजोषाः ॥
verses.rom:
manyurindro manyurevasa devo manyurhota varuno jatavedah |
manyum visha idate manushiryah pahi no manyo tapasa sajoshah ||
verses.en: Fury [was] Indra, fury indeed was a god; fury [was] priest (hótar), Varuṇa, Jātavedas; the clans (víç) which are descended from Manu (mā́nuṣa) praise fury; protect us, O fury, in accord with fervor (tápas).

verses.sa:
अभीहि मन्यो तवसस्तवीयान् तपसा युजा वि जहि शत्रून् ।
अमित्रहा वृत्रहा दस्युहा च विश्वा वसून्या भरा त्वं नः ॥
verses.rom:
abhihi manyo tavasastaviyan tapasa yuja vi jahi shatrun |
amitraha vritraha dasyuha cha vishva vasunya bhara tvam nah ||
verses.en: Attack, O fury, being mightier than a mighty one; with fervor as ally smite apart the foes; slayer of enemies, slayer of Vṛtra, and slayer of barbarians, do thou bring to us all [their] good things.

verses.sa:
त्वं हि मन्यो अभिभूत्योजाः स्वयंभूर्भामो अभिमातिषाहः ।
विश्वचर्षणिः सहुरिः सहीयान् अस्मास्वोजः पृतनासु धेहि ॥
verses.rom:
tvam hi manyo abhibhutyojah svayambhurbhamo abhimatishahah |
vishvacharshanih sahurih sahiyan asmasvojah pritanasu dhehi ||
verses.en: Since thou, O fury, art of overcoming force, self-existent, terrible, overpowering hostile plotters, belonging to all men (-carṣaṇí), powerful, very powerful—do thou put in us force in fights.

verses.sa:
अभागः सन्न् अप परेतो अस्मि तव क्रत्वा तविषस्य प्रचेतः ।
तं त्वा मन्यो अक्रतुर्जिहीडाहं स्वा तनूर्बलदावा न एहि ॥
verses.rom:
abhagah sann apa pareto asmi tava kratva tavishasya prachetah |
tam tva manyo akraturjihidaham sva tanurbaladava na ehi ||
verses.en: Being portionless, I am gone far away, by the action (? krátu) of thee that art mighty, O forethoughtful one; so at thee, O fury, I, actionless, was wrathful; come to us, thine own self (tanū́), giving strength.

verses.sa:
अयं ते अस्म्युप न एह्यर्वाङ्प्रतीचीनः सहुरे विश्वदावन् ।
मन्यो वज्रिन्न् अभि न आ ववृत्स्व हनाव दस्यूंरुत बोध्यापेः ॥
verses.rom:
ayam te asmyupa na ehyarvanpratichinah sahure vishvadavan |
manyo vajrinn abhi na a vavritsva hanava dasyumruta bodhyapeh ||
verses.en: Here I am for thee; come hitherward unto us, meeting (pratīcīná) [us], O powerful, all-giving one; O thunderbolt-bearing fury, turn hither to us; let us (two) slay the barbarians; and do thou know thy partner (āpí).

verses.sa:
अभि प्रेहि दक्षिणतो भवा नोऽधा वृत्राणि जङ्घनाव भूरि ।
जुहोमि ते धरुणं मध्वो अग्रमुभावुपांशु प्रथमा पिबाव ॥
verses.rom:
abhi prehi dakshinato bhava no'dha vritrani janghanava bhuri |
juhomi te dharunam madhvo agramubhavupamshu prathama pibava ||
verses.en: Go thou forth against [them]; be on our right hand; then will we (two) smite and slay many Vṛtras; I offer to thee the sustaining top of the sweet (mádhu); let us both drink first the initial draught (? upāṅçú).

verses.sa:
अप नः शोशुचदघमग्ने शुशुग्ध्या रयिम् ।
अप नः शोशुचदघम् ॥
verses.rom:
apa nah shoshuchadaghamagne shushugdhya rayim |
apa nah shoshuchadagham ||
verses.en: Gleaming (çuc) away our evil (aghá), O Agni, gleam thou wealth unto [us]: gleaming away our evil.

verses.sa:
सुक्षेत्रिया सुगातुया वसूया च यजामहे ।
अप नः शोशुचदघम् ॥
verses.rom:
sukshetriya sugatuya vasuya cha yajamahe |
apa nah shoshuchadagham ||
verses.en: With desire of pleasant fields, of welfare, of good things, we sacrifice—gleaming away our evil—

verses.sa:
प्र यद्भन्दिष्ठ एषां प्रास्माकासश्च सूरयः ।
अप नः शोशुचदघम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra yadbhandishtha esham prasmakasashcha surayah |
apa nah shoshuchadagham ||
verses.en: In order that the most excellent of them, and in order that our patrons (sūrí)—gleaming away our evil—

verses.sa:
प्र यत्ते अग्ने सूरयो जायेमहि प्र ते वयम् ।
अप नः शोशुचदघम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra yatte agne surayo jayemahi pra te vayam |
apa nah shoshuchadagham ||
verses.en: In order that thy patrons, O Agni; in order [namely] that we may be propagated for thee with progeny—gleaming away our evil—

verses.sa:
प्र यदग्नेः सहस्वतो विश्वतो यन्ति भानवः ।
अप नः शोशुचदघम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra yadagneh sahasvato vishvato yanti bhanavah |
apa nah shoshuchadagham ||
verses.en: As of the powerful Agni the lusters (bhānú) go forth in every direction—gleaming away our evil.

verses.sa:
त्वं हि विश्वतोमुख विश्वतः परिभूरसि ।
अप नः शोशुचदघम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam hi vishvatomukha vishvatah paribhurasi |
apa nah shoshuchadagham ||
verses.en: For, O thou that facest in every direction, thou art [our] encompasser on all sides: gleaming away our evil.

verses.sa:
द्विषो नो विश्वतोमुखाति नावेव पारय ।
अप नः शोशुचदघम् ॥
verses.rom:
dvisho no vishvatomukhati naveva paraya |
apa nah shoshuchadagham ||
verses.en: Our haters, O thou that facest in every direction, do thou make us pass over as with a boat: gleaming away our evil.

verses.sa:
स नः सिन्धुमिव नावाति पर्ष स्वस्तये ।
अप नः शोशुचदघम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa nah sindhumiva navati parsha svastaye |
apa nah shoshuchadagham ||
verses.en: Do thou pass us over unto well-being, as [over] a river with a boat: gleaming away our evil.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मास्य शीर्षं बृहदस्य पृष्ठं वामदेव्यमुदरमोदनस्य ।
छन्दांसि पक्षौ मुखमस्य सत्यं विष्टारी जातस्तपसोऽधि यज्ञः ॥
verses.rom:
brahmasya shirsham brihadasya prishtham vamadevyamudaramodanasya |
chhandamsi pakshau mukhamasya satyam vishtari jatastapaso'dhi yajnah ||
verses.en: The bráhman [is] its head, the bṛhát its back, the vāmadevyá the belly of the rice-mess; the meters [are] the (two) sides (wings ?), truth its mouth; the viṣṭārín [is] a sacrifice born out of fervor (tápas).

verses.sa:
अनस्थाः पूताः पवनेन शुद्धाः शुचयः शुचिमपि यन्ति लोकम् ।
नैषां शिश्नं प्र दहति जातवेदाः स्वर्गे लोके बहु स्त्रैणमेषाम् ॥
verses.rom:
anasthah putah pavanena shuddhah shuchayah shuchimapi yanti lokam |
naisham shishnam pra dahati jatavedah svarge loke bahu strainamesham ||
verses.en: Boneless, purified, cleansed with the purifier, bright (çúci), they go to a bright world; Jātavedas burns not away their virile member; in the heavenly (svargá) world much women-folk is theirs.

verses.sa:
विष्टारिणमोदनं ये पचन्ति नैनान् अवर्तिः सचते कदा चन ।
आस्ते यम उप याति देवान्त्सं गन्धर्वैर्मदते सोम्येभिः ॥
verses.rom:
vishtarinamodanam ye pachanti nainan avartih sachate kada chana |
aste yama upa yati devantsam gandharvairmadate somyebhih ||
verses.en: Whoso cook the viṣṭārín rice-mess, ruin (ávarti) fastens not on them at any time; [such a one] stays (as) with Yama, goes to the gods, revels with the soma-drinking (somyá) Gandharvas.

verses.sa:
विष्टारिणमोदनं ये पचन्ति नैनान् यमः परि मुष्णाति रेतः ।
रथी ह भूत्वा रथयान ईयते पक्षी ह भूत्वाति दिवः समेति ॥
verses.rom:
vishtarinamodanam ye pachanti nainan yamah pari mushnati retah |
rathi ha bhutva rathayana iyate pakshi ha bhutvati divah sameti ||
verses.en: Whoso cook the viṣṭārín rice-mess, them Yama robs not of their seed; becoming chariot-owner, [such a one] goes about upon a chariot-road; becoming winged, he goes all across the skies.

verses.sa:
एष यज्ञानां विततो वहिष्ठो विष्टारिणं पक्त्वा दिवमा विवेश ।
आण्डीकं कुमुदं सं तनोति बिसं शालूकं शफको मुलाली ।
एतास्त्वा धारा उप यन्तु सर्वाः स्वर्गे लोके मधुमत्पिन्वमाना उप त्वा तिष्ठन्तु पुष्करिणीः समन्ताः ॥
verses.rom:
esha yajnanam vitato vahishtho vishtarinam paktva divama vivesha |
andikam kumudam sam tanoti bisam shalukam shaphako mulali |
etastva dhara upa yantu sarvah svarge loke madhumatpinvamana upa tva tishthantu pushkarinih samantah ||
verses.en: This, extended, is of sacrifices the best carrier; having cooked the viṣṭārín, one has entered the sky; the bulb-bearing lotus spreads (sam-tam), the bísa, çālū́ka, çáphaka, mulālī́: let all these streams (dhā́rā) come unto thee, swelling honeyedly in the heavenly (svargá) world; let complete (sámanta) lotus-ponds approach thee.

verses.sa:
घृतह्रदा मधुकूलाः सुरोदकाः क्षीरेण पूर्णा उदकेन दध्ना ।
एतास्त्वा धारा उप यन्तु सर्वाः स्वर्गे लोके मधुमत्पिन्वमाना उप त्वा तिष्ठन्तु पुष्करिणीः समन्ताः ॥
verses.rom:
ghritahrada madhukulah surodakah kshirena purna udakena dadhna |
etastva dhara upa yantu sarvah svarge loke madhumatpinvamana upa tva tishthantu pushkarinih samantah ||
verses.en: Having pools of ghee, having slopes of honey, having strong drink (súrā) for water, filled with milk (kṣīrá), with water, with curds—let all these etc. etc.

verses.sa:
चतुरः कुम्भांश्चतुर्धा ददामि क्षीरेण पूर्नामुदकेन दध्ना ।
एतास्त्वा धारा उप यन्तु सर्वाः स्वर्गे लोके मधुमत्पिन्वमाना उप त्वा तिष्ठन्तु पुष्करिणीः समन्ताः ॥
verses.rom:
chaturah kumbhamshchaturdha dadami kshirena purnamudakena dadhna |
etastva dhara upa yantu sarvah svarge loke madhumatpinvamana upa tva tishthantu pushkarinih samantah ||
verses.en: Four vessels (kumbhá), four-fold, I give, filled with milk, with water, with curds—let all these etc. etc.

verses.sa:
इममोदनं नि दधे ब्राह्मणेषु विष्टारिणं लोकजितं स्वर्गम् ।
स मे मा क्षेष्ट स्वधया पिन्वमानो विश्वरूपा धेनुः कामदुघा मे अस्तु ॥
verses.rom:
imamodanam ni dadhe brahmaneshu vishtarinam lokajitam svargam |
sa me ma ksheshta svadhaya pinvamano vishvarupa dhenuh kamadugha me astu ||
verses.en: This rice-mess I deposit in the Brāhmans, the viṣṭārín, world-conquering, heaven-going (svargá); let it not be destroyed (kṣi) for me, swelling with svadhā́; be it a cow of all forms, milking my desire.

verses.sa:
यमोदनं प्रथमजा ऋतस्य प्रजापतिस्तपसा ब्रह्मणेऽपचत्।
यो लोकानां विधृतिर्नाभिरेषात्तेनौदनेनाति तराणि मृत्युम् ॥
verses.rom:
yamodanam prathamaja ritasya prajapatistapasa brahmane'pachat|
yo lokanam vidhritirnabhireshattenaudanenati tarani mrityum ||
verses.en: The rice-mess which Prajāpati, first-born of righteousness, cooked with fervor (tápas) for Brahmán; which, separator of the worlds, shall not harm (?)—by that rice-mess let me overpass death.

verses.sa:
येनातरन् भूतकृतोऽति मृत्युं यमन्वविन्दन् तपसा श्रमेण ।
यं पपाच ब्रह्मणे ब्रह्म पूर्वं तेनौदनेनाति तराणि मृत्युम् ॥
verses.rom:
yenataran bhutakrito'ti mrityum yamanvavindan tapasa shramena |
yam papacha brahmane brahma purvam tenaudanenati tarani mrityum ||
verses.en: That by which the being-makers overpassed death; which they discovered by fervor, by toil (çráma); which the bráhman of old cooked for Brahmán—by that rice-mess let me overpass death.

verses.sa:
यो दाधार पृथिवीं विश्वभोजसं यो अन्तरिक्षमापृणाद्रसेन ।
यो अस्तभ्नाद्दिवमूर्ध्वो महिम्ना तेनौदनेनाति तराणि मृत्युम् ॥
verses.rom:
yo dadhara prithivim vishvabhojasam yo antarikshamaprinadrasena |
yo astabhnaddivamurdhvo mahimna tenaudanenati tarani mrityum ||
verses.en: That which sustained the all-nourishing earth; which filled the atmosphere with sap; which, uplifted, established the sky with might—by that rice-mess let me overpass death.

verses.sa:
यस्मान् मासा निर्मितास्त्रिंशदराः संवत्सरो यस्मान् निर्मितो द्वादशारः ।
अहोरात्रा यं परियन्तो नापुस्तेनौदनेनाति तराणि मृत्युम् ॥
verses.rom:
yasman masa nirmitastrimshadarah samvatsaro yasman nirmito dvadasharah |
ahoratra yam pariyanto napustenaudanenati tarani mrityum ||
verses.en: That out of which were fashioned the thirty-spoked months; out of which was fashioned the twelve-spoked year; that which circling days-and-nights did not attain—by that rice-mess let me overpass death.

verses.sa:
यः प्राणदः प्राणदवान् बभूव यस्मै लोका घृतवन्तः क्षरन्ति ।
ज्योतिष्मतीः प्रदिशो यस्य सर्वास्तेनौदनेनाति तराणि मृत्युम् ॥
verses.rom:
yah pranadah pranadavan babhuva yasmai loka ghritavantah ksharanti |
jyotishmatih pradisho yasya sarvastenaudanenati tarani mrityum ||
verses.en: That which became breath-giving, possessing breath-giving ones (?); for which worlds rich in ghee flow; whose are all the light-filled directions—by that rice-mess let me overpass death.

verses.sa:
यस्मात्पक्वादमृतं संबभूव यो गायत्र्या अधिपतिर्बभूव ।
यस्मिन् वेदा निहिता विश्वरूपास्तेनौदनेनाति तराणि मृत्युम् ॥
verses.rom:
yasmatpakvadamritam sambabhuva yo gayatrya adhipatirbabhuva |
yasmin veda nihita vishvarupastenaudanenati tarani mrityum ||
verses.en: From which, when cooked, the immortal (amṛ́ta) came into being; which was the over-lord of the gāyatrī́; in which are deposited the Vedas of all forms—by that rice-mess let me overpass death.

verses.sa:
अव बाधे द्विषन्तं देवपीयुं सपत्ना ये मेऽप ते भवन्तु ।
ब्रह्मौदनं विश्वजितं पचामि शृण्वन्तु मे श्रद्दधानस्य देवाः ॥
verses.rom:
ava badhe dvishantam devapiyum sapatna ye me'pa te bhavantu |
brahmaudanam vishvajitam pachami shrinvantu me shraddadhanasya devah ||
verses.en: I beat down the hater, the god-insulter; what rivals are mine, let them be [driven] away; I cook the all-conquering bráhman-rice-mess; let the gods hear me who am full of faith.

verses.sa:
तान्त्सत्यौजाः प्र दहत्वग्निर्वैश्वानरो वृषा ।
यो नो दुरस्याद्दिप्साच्चाथो यो नो अरातियात् ॥
verses.rom:
tantsatyaujah pra dahatvagnirvaishvanaro vrisha |
yo no durasyaddipsachchatho yo no aratiyat ||
verses.en: Them let him of real force burn forth—Agni Vāiçvānara, the bull; whoso shall abuse and seek to harm us, likewise whoso shall play the niggard toward us.

verses.sa:
यो नो दिप्साददिप्सतो दिप्सतो यश्च दिप्सति ।
वैश्वानरस्य दंष्ट्रयोरग्नेरपि दधामि तम् ॥
verses.rom:
yo no dipsadadipsato dipsato yashcha dipsati |
vaishvanarasya damshtrayoragnerapi dadhami tam ||
verses.en: Whoso shall seek to harm us not seeking to harm, and whoso seeks to harm us seeking to harm—in the two tusks of Agni Vāiçvānara do I set him.

verses.sa:
य आगरे मृगयन्ते प्रतिक्रोशेऽमावास्ये ।
क्रव्यादो अन्यान् दिप्सतः सर्वांस्तान्त्सहसा सहे ॥
verses.rom:
ya agare mrigayante pratikroshe'mavasye |
kravyado anyan dipsatah sarvamstantsahasa sahe ||
verses.en: They who hunt in assent (? āgará), in counter-clamor (? pratikroçá), on new-moon [day], the flesh-eating ones, seeking to harm others—all those I overpower with power.

verses.sa:
सहे पिशाचान्त्सहसैषां द्रविणं ददे ।
सर्वान् दुरस्यतो हन्मि सं म आकूतिर्ऋध्यताम् ॥
verses.rom:
sahe pishachantsahasaisham dravinam dade |
sarvan durasyato hanmi sam ma akutirridhyatam ||
verses.en: I overpower the piçācás with power; I take to myself their property; I slay all the abusers; let my design be successful.

verses.sa:
ये देवास्तेन हासन्ते सूर्येण मिमते जवम् ।
नदीषु पर्वतेषु ये सं तैः पशुभिर्विदे ॥
verses.rom:
ye devastena hasante suryena mimate javam |
nadishu parvateshu ye sam taih pashubhirvide ||
verses.en: The gods that hasten (hās) with him—they measure speed with the sun—with those cattle (paçú) that are in the streams, in the mountains, I am in concord.

verses.sa:
तपनो अस्मि पिशाचानां व्याघ्रो गोमतामिव ।
श्वानः सिंहमिव दृष्ट्वा ते न विन्दन्ते न्यञ्चनम् ॥
verses.rom:
tapano asmi pishachanam vyaghro gomatamiva |
shvanah simhamiva drishtva te na vindante nyanchanam ||
verses.en: I am a vexer (tápana) of the piçācás, as a tiger of them that have kine; like dogs on seeing a lion, they do not find a hiding-place (nyáñcana).

verses.sa:
न पिशाचैः सं शक्नोमि न स्तेनैः न वनर्गुभिः ।
पिशाचास्तस्मान् नश्यन्ति यमहं ग्राममाविशे ॥
verses.rom:
na pishachaih sam shaknomi na stenaih na vanargubhih |
pishachastasman nashyanti yamaham gramamavishe ||
verses.en: I cannot [bear] with piçācás, nor with thieves, nor with savages (? vanargú); the piçācás disappear from that village which I enter.

verses.sa:
यं ग्राममाविशत इदमुग्रं सहो मम ।
पिशाचास्तस्मान् नश्यन्ति न पापमुप जानते ॥
verses.rom:
yam gramamavishata idamugram saho mama |
pishachastasman nashyanti na papamupa janate ||
verses.en: Whatever village this formidable power of mine enters, from that the piçācás disappear; [there] they devise not evil.

verses.sa:
ये मा क्रोधयन्ति लपिता हस्तिनं मशका इव ।
तान् अहं मन्ये दुर्हितान् जने अल्पशयून् इव ॥
verses.rom:
ye ma krodhayanti lapita hastinam mashaka iva |
tan aham manye durhitan jane alpashayun iva ||
verses.en: They who anger me, making a noise, as flies an elephant—them I think ill off, like mites (?) on a man (jána).

verses.sa:
अभि तं निर्ऋतिर्धत्तामश्वमिव अश्वाभिधान्या ।
मल्वो यो मह्यं क्रुध्यति स उ पाशान् न मुच्यते ॥
verses.rom:
abhi tam nirritirdhattamashvamiva ashvabhidhanya |
malvo yo mahyam krudhyati sa u pashan na muchyate ||
verses.en: Let perdition halter him, as a horse with a horse-halter (-abhi-dhā́nī); the fool (malvá) that is angry at me, he is not loosed from the fetter.

verses.sa:
त्वया पूर्वमथर्वाणो जघ्नू रक्षांस्योषधे ।
त्वया जघान कश्यपस्त्वया कण्वो अगस्त्यः ॥
verses.rom:
tvaya purvamatharvano jaghnu rakshamsyoshadhe |
tvaya jaghana kashyapastvaya kanvo agastyah ||
verses.en: By thee of old the Atharvans slew the demons, O herb; by thee did Kaçyapa slay; by thee Kaṇva, Agastya.

verses.sa:
त्वया वयमप्सरसो गन्धर्वांस्चातयामहे ।
अजशृङ्ग्यज रक्षः सर्वान् गन्धेन नाशय ॥
verses.rom:
tvaya vayamapsaraso gandharvamschatayamahe |
ajashringyaja rakshah sarvan gandhena nashaya ||
verses.en: By thee do we expel (cat) the Apsarases, the Gandharvas; O goat-horned one, drive the demon; make all disappear by [thy] smell.

verses.sa:
नदीं यन्त्वप्सरसोऽपां तारमवश्वसम् ।
गुल्गुलूः पीला नलद्यौक्षगन्धिः प्रमन्दनी ।
तत्परेताप्सरसः प्रतिबुद्धा अभूतन ॥
verses.rom:
nadim yantvapsaraso'pam taramavashvasam |
gulguluh pila naladyaukshagandhih pramandani |
tatparetapsarasah pratibuddha abhutana ||
verses.en: Let the Apsarases go to the stream, to the loud (?) down-blowing of the waters: Guggulū, Pīlā, Naladī, Āukṣagandhi, Pramandanī: so go away, ye Apsarases; ye have been recognized.

verses.sa:
यत्राश्वत्था न्यग्रोधा महावृक्षाः शिखण्डिनः ।
तत्परेताप्सरसः प्रतिबुद्धा अभूतन ॥
verses.rom:
yatrashvattha nyagrodha mahavrikshah shikhandinah |
tatparetapsarasah pratibuddha abhutana ||
verses.en: Where [are] the açvatthás, the nyagródhas, great trees, with crests: thither go away, ye Apsarases; ye have been recognized.

verses.sa:
यत्र वः प्रेङ्खा हरिता अर्जुना उत यत्राघाताः कर्कर्यः संवदन्ति ।
तत्परेताप्सरसः प्रतिबुद्धा अभूतन ॥
verses.rom:
yatra vah prenkha harita arjuna uta yatraghatah karkaryah samvadanti |
tatparetapsarasah pratibuddha abhutana ||
verses.en: Where [are] your swings, green and whitish; where cymbals [and] lutes sound together—thither go away, ye Apsarases; ye have been recognized.

verses.sa:
एयमगन्न् ओषधीनां वीरुधां वीर्यावती ।
अजशृङ्ग्यराटकी तीक्ष्णशृङ्गी व्यृषतु ॥
verses.rom:
eyamagann oshadhinam virudham viryavati |
ajashringyarataki tikshnashringi vyrishatu ||
verses.en: Hither hath come this mighty one (vīryàvant) of the herbs, of the plants; let the goat-horned arāṭakī́, the sharp-horned, push out.

verses.sa:
आनृत्यतः शिखण्डिनो गन्धर्वस्याप्सरापतेः ।
भिनद्मि मुष्कावपि यामि शेपः ॥
verses.rom:
anrityatah shikhandino gandharvasyapsarapateh |
bhinadmi mushkavapi yami shepah ||
verses.en: Of the hither-dancing, crested Gandharva, Apsaras-lord, I split the testicles, I bind fast (?) the member.

verses.sa:
भीमा इन्द्रस्य हेतयः शतमृष्टीरयस्मयीः ।
ताभिर्हविरदान् गन्धर्वान् अवकादान् व्यृषतु ॥
verses.rom:
bhima indrasya hetayah shatamrishtirayasmayih |
tabhirhaviradan gandharvan avakadan vyrishatu ||
verses.en: Terrible are Indra's missiles (hetí), a hundred spears of iron; with them let him push out the oblation-eating, ávakā-eating Gandharvas.

verses.sa:
भीमा इन्द्रस्य हेतयः शतमृष्टीर्हिरण्ययीः ।
ताभिर्हविरदान् गन्धर्वान् अवकादान् व्यृषतु ॥
verses.rom:
bhima indrasya hetayah shatamrishtirhiranyayih |
tabhirhaviradan gandharvan avakadan vyrishatu ||
verses.en: Terrible are Indra's missiles, a hundred spears of gold; with them let him push out the oblation-eating, ávakā-eating Gandharvas.

verses.sa:
अवकादान् अभिशोचान् अप्सु ज्योतय मामकान् ।
पिशाचान्त्सर्वान् ओषधे प्र मृणीहि सहस्व च ॥
verses.rom:
avakadan abhishochan apsu jyotaya mamakan |
pishachantsarvan oshadhe pra mrinihi sahasva cha ||
verses.en: The ávakā-eating ones, scorching, making light (?) in the waters—all the piçācás, O herb, do thou slaughter and overpower.

verses.sa:
श्वेवैकः कपिरिवैकः कुमारः सर्वकेशकः ।
प्रियो दृश इव भूत्वा गन्धर्वः सचते स्त्रियस्।
तमितो नाशयामसि ब्रह्मणा वीर्यावता ॥
verses.rom:
shvevaikah kapirivaikah kumarah sarvakeshakah |
priyo drisha iva bhutva gandharvah sachate striyas|
tamito nashayamasi brahmana viryavata ||
verses.en: One as it were a dog, one as it were an ape, a boy all hairy—having become as it were dear to see, the Gandharva fastens upon (sac) women; him we make disappear from here by [our] mighty (vīryàvant) incantation (bráhman).

verses.sa:
जाया इद्वो अप्सरसो गन्धर्वाः पतयो यूयम् ।
अप धावतामर्त्या मर्त्यान् मा सचध्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
jaya idvo apsaraso gandharvah patayo yuyam |
apa dhavatamartya martyan ma sachadhvam ||
verses.en: Your wives, verily, are the Apsarases; O Gandharvas, ye are [their] husbands; run away, O immortal ones; fasten not on mortals.

verses.sa:
उद्भिन्दतीं संजयन्तीमप्सरां साधुदेविनीम् ।
ग्लहे कृतानि कृण्वानामप्सरां तामिह हुवे ॥
verses.rom:
udbhindatim samjayantimapsaram sadhudevinim |
glahe kritani krinvanamapsaram tamiha huve ||
verses.en: The up-shooting, all-conquering, successfully-playing Apsaras, that wins (kṛ) the winnings in the pool (? gláha)—that Apsaras I call on here.

verses.sa:
विचिन्वतीमाकिरन्तीमप्सरां साधुदेविनीम् ।
ग्लहे कृतानि गृह्णानामप्सरां तामिह हुवे ॥
verses.rom:
vichinvatimakirantimapsaram sadhudevinim |
glahe kritani grihnanamapsaram tamiha huve ||
verses.en: The distributing (vi-ci), on-strewing (ā-kir), successfully-playing Apsaras, that seizes (grah) the winnings in the pool—that Apsaras I call on here.

verses.sa:
यायैः परिनृत्यत्याददाना कृतं ग्लहात्।
सा नः कृतानि सीषती प्रहामाप्नोतु मायया ।
सा नः पयस्वत्यैतु मा नो जैषुरिदं धनम् ॥
verses.rom:
yayaih parinrityatyadadana kritam glahat|
sa nah kritani sishati prahamapnotu mayaya |
sa nah payasvatyaitu ma no jaishuridam dhanam ||
verses.en: She who dances about with the dice (? áya), taking to herself the winning from the pool—let her, trying to gain (?) for us the winnings, obtain the stake (? prahā́) by magic (māyā́); let her come to us rich in milk; let them not conquer from us this riches.

verses.sa:
या अक्षेषु प्रमोदन्ते शुचं क्रोधं च बिभ्रती ।
आनन्दिनीं प्रमोदिनीमप्सरां तामिह हुवे ॥
verses.rom:
ya aksheshu pramodante shucham krodham cha bibhrati |
anandinim pramodinimapsaram tamiha huve ||
verses.en: She who delights (pra-mud) in the dice (akṣá), bringing (bhṛ) pain and anger—the rejoicing, the dehghting one: that Apsaras I call on here.

verses.sa:
सूर्यस्य रश्मीन् अनु याः सञ्चरन्ति मरीचीर्वा या अनुसञ्चरन्ति ।
यासामृषभो दूरतो वाजिनीवान्त्सद्यः सर्वान् लोकान् पर्येति रक्षन् ।
स न ऐतु होममिमं जुषाणोऽन्तरिक्षेण सह वाजिनीवान् ॥
verses.rom:
suryasya rashmin anu yah sancharanti marichirva ya anusancharanti |
yasamrishabho durato vajinivantsadyah sarvan lokan paryeti rakshan |
sa na aitu homamimam jushano'ntarikshena saha vajinivan ||
verses.en: They who (f.) go about (sam-car) after the rays of the sun, or who go about after [its] beams (márīci); of whom the mighty (? vājínīvant) bull from afar moves around (pari-i) at once all the worlds, defending—let him come unto us, enjoying this libation, together with the atmosphere, he the mighty one.

verses.sa:
अन्तरिक्षेण सह वाजिनीवन् कर्कीं वत्सामिह रक्ष वाजिन् ।
इमे ते स्तोका बहुला एह्यर्वाङियं ते कर्कीह ते मनोऽस्तु ॥
verses.rom:
antarikshena saha vajinivan karkim vatsamiha raksha vajin |
ime te stoka bahula ehyarvaniyam te karkiha te mano'stu ||
verses.en: Together with the atmosphere, O mighty one; defend thou here the karkī́ calf, O vigorous one (vājín); here are abundant drops (stoká) for thee; come hitherward; this is thy karkī́; here be thy mind.

verses.sa:
अन्तरिक्षेण सह वाजिनीवन् कर्कीं वत्सामिह रक्ष वाजिन् ।
अयं घासो अयं व्रज इह वत्सां नि बध्नीमः ।
यथानाम व ईश्महे स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
antarikshena saha vajinivan karkim vatsamiha raksha vajin |
ayam ghaso ayam vraja iha vatsam ni badhnimah |
yathanama va ishmahe svaha ||
verses.en: Together with the atmosphere, O mighty one; defend thou here the karkī́ calf, O vigorous one; this is fodder; this is the pen; here we bind (ni-bandh) the calf; according to name we master you: hail!

verses.sa:
पृथिव्यामग्नये समनमन्त्स आर्ध्नोत्।
यथा पृथिव्यामग्नये समनमन्न् एवा मह्यं संनमः सं नमन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
prithivyamagnaye samanamantsa ardhnot|
yatha prithivyamagnaye samanamann eva mahyam samnamah sam namantu ||
verses.en: On the earth they paid reverence (sam-nam) to Agni; he throve (ṛdh); as on earth they paid reverence to Agni, so let the reverencers pay reverence to me.

verses.sa:
पृथिवी धेनुस्तस्या अग्निर्वत्सः ।
सा मेऽग्निना वत्सेनेषमूर्जं कामं दुहाम् ।
आयुः प्रथमं प्रजां पोषं रयिं स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
prithivi dhenustasya agnirvatsah |
sa me'gnina vatseneshamurjam kamam duham |
ayuh prathamam prajam posham rayim svaha ||
verses.en: Earth [is] milch-cow; of her Agni [is] calf; let her, with Agni as calf, milk for me food (íṣ), refreshment, [my] desire, life-time first, progeny, prosperity, wealth: hail!

verses.sa:
अन्तरिक्षे वायवे समनमन्त्स आर्ध्नोत्।
यथान्तरिक्षे वायवे समनमन्न् एवा मह्यं संनमः सं नमन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
antarikshe vayave samanamantsa ardhnot|
yathantarikshe vayave samanamann eva mahyam samnamah sam namantu ||
verses.en: In the atmosphere they paid reverence to Vāyu; he throve; as in the atmosphere they paid reverence to Vāyu, so let the reverencers pay reverence to me.

verses.sa:
अन्तरिक्षं धेनुस्तस्या वायुर्वत्सः ।
सा मे वायुना वत्सेनेषमूर्जं कामं दुहाम् ।
आयुः प्रथमं प्रजां पोषं रयिं स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
antariksham dhenustasya vayurvatsah |
sa me vayuna vatseneshamurjam kamam duham |
ayuh prathamam prajam posham rayim svaha ||
verses.en: The atmosphere is milch-cow; of her Vāyu is calf; let her, with Vāyu as calf, milk for me etc. etc.

verses.sa:
दिव्यादित्याय समनमन्त्स आर्ध्नोत्।
यथा दिव्यादित्याय समनमन्न् एवा मह्यं संनमः सं नमन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
divyadityaya samanamantsa ardhnot|
yatha divyadityaya samanamann eva mahyam samnamah sam namantu ||
verses.en: In the sky they paid reverence to Āditya; he throve; as in the sky they paid reverence to Āditya, so let the reverencers pay reverence to me.

verses.sa:
द्यौर्धेनुस्तस्या आदित्यो वत्सः ।
सा म आदित्येन वत्सेनेषमूर्जं कामं दुहाम् ।
आयुः प्रथमं प्रजां पोषं रयिं स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
dyaurdhenustasya adityo vatsah |
sa ma adityena vatseneshamurjam kamam duham |
ayuh prathamam prajam posham rayim svaha ||
verses.en: The sky is milch-cow; of her Āditya is calf; let her, with Āditya as calf, milk for me etc. etc.

verses.sa:
दिक्षु चन्द्राय समनमन्त्स आर्ध्नोत्।
यथा दिक्षु चन्द्राय समनमन्न् एवा मह्यं संनमः सं नमन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
dikshu chandraya samanamantsa ardhnot|
yatha dikshu chandraya samanamann eva mahyam samnamah sam namantu ||
verses.en: In the quarters they paid reverence to the moon (candrá); it throve; as in the quarters they paid reverence to the moon, so let the reverencers pay reverence to me.

verses.sa:
दिशो धेनवस्तासां चन्द्रो वत्सः ।
ता मे चन्द्रेण वत्सेनेषमूर्जं कामं दुहामायुः प्रथमं प्रजां पोषं रयिं स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
disho dhenavastasam chandro vatsah |
ta me chandrena vatseneshamurjam kamam duhamayuh prathamam prajam posham rayim svaha ||
verses.en: The quarters are milch-cows; of them the moon is calf; let them, with the moon as calf, milk for me etc. etc.

verses.sa:
अग्नावग्निश्चरति प्रविष्ट ऋषीणां पुत्रो अभिशस्तिपा उ ।
नमस्कारेण नमसा ते जुहोमि मा देवानां मिथुया कर्म भागम् ॥
verses.rom:
agnavagnishcharati pravishta rishinam putro abhishastipa u |
namaskarena namasa te juhomi ma devanam mithuya karma bhagam ||
verses.en: Agni moves (car), entered into the fire, son of the seers, protector against imprecation; with homage-paying, with homage, I make offering to thee; let us not make falsely the share of the gods.

verses.sa:
हृदा पूतं मनसा जातवेदो विश्वानि देव वयुनानि विद्वान् ।
सप्तास्यानि तव जातवेदस्तेभ्यो जुहोमि स जुषस्व हव्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
hrida putam manasa jatavedo vishvani deva vayunani vidvan |
saptasyani tava jatavedastebhyo juhomi sa jushasva havyam ||
verses.en: Purified with the heart, with the mind, O Jātavedas—knowing all the ways (vayúna), O god; seven mouths are thine, O Jātavedas; to them I make offering—do thou enjoy the oblation.

verses.sa:
ये पुरस्ताज्जुह्वति जातवेदः प्राच्या दिशोऽभिदासन्त्यस्मान् ।
अग्निमृत्वा ते पराञ्चो व्यथन्तां प्रत्यगेनान् प्रतिसरेण हन्मि ॥
verses.rom:
ye purastajjuhvati jatavedah prachya disho'bhidasantyasman |
agnimritva te parancho vyathantam pratyagenan pratisarena hanmi ||

verses.sa:
ये दक्षिणतो जुह्वति जातवेदो दक्षिणाया दिशोऽभिदासन्त्यस्मान् ।
यममृत्वा ते पराञ्चो व्यथन्तां प्रत्यगेना प्रतिसरेण हन्मि ॥
verses.rom:
ye dakshinato juhvati jatavedo dakshinaya disho'bhidasantyasman |
yamamritva te parancho vyathantam pratyagena pratisarena hanmi ||

verses.sa:
ये पश्चाज्जुह्वति जातवेदः प्रतीच्या दिशोऽभिदासन्त्यस्मान् ।
वरुणमृत्वा ते पराञ्चो व्यथन्तां प्रत्यगेनान् प्रतिसरेण हन्मि ॥
verses.rom:
ye pashchajjuhvati jatavedah pratichya disho'bhidasantyasman |
varunamritva te parancho vyathantam pratyagenan pratisarena hanmi ||

verses.sa:
य उत्तरतो जुह्वति जातवेद उदीच्या दिशोऽभिदासन्त्यस्मान् ।
सोममृत्वा ते पराञ्चो व्यथन्तां प्रत्यगेनान् प्रतिसरेण हन्मि ॥
verses.rom:
ya uttarato juhvati jataveda udichya disho'bhidasantyasman |
somamritva te parancho vyathantam pratyagenan pratisarena hanmi ||

verses.sa:
येऽधस्ताज्जुह्वति जातवेद उदीच्या दिशोऽभिदासन्त्यस्मान् ।
भूमिमृत्वा ते पराञ्चो व्यथन्तां प्रत्यगेनान् प्रतिसरेण हन्मि ॥
verses.rom:
ye'dhastajjuhvati jataveda udichya disho'bhidasantyasman |
bhumimritva te parancho vyathantam pratyagenan pratisarena hanmi ||

verses.sa:
येऽन्तरिक्षाज्जुह्वति जातवेदो व्यध्वाया दिशोऽभिदासन्त्यस्मान् ।
वायुमृत्वा ते पराञ्चो व्यथन्तां प्रत्यगेनान् प्रतिसरेण हन्मि ॥
verses.rom:
ye'ntarikshajjuhvati jatavedo vyadhvaya disho'bhidasantyasman |
vayumritva te parancho vyathantam pratyagenan pratisarena hanmi ||

verses.sa:
य उपरिष्टाज्जुह्वति जातवेद ऊर्ध्वाया दिशोऽभिदासन्त्यस्मान् ।
सूर्यमृत्वा ते पराञ्चो व्यथन्तां प्रत्यगेनान् प्रतिसरेण हन्मि ॥
verses.rom:
ya uparishtajjuhvati jataveda urdhvaya disho'bhidasantyasman |
suryamritva te parancho vyathantam pratyagenan pratisarena hanmi ||

verses.sa:
ये दिशामन्तर्देशेभ्यो जुह्वति जातवेदः सर्वाभ्यो दिग्भ्योऽभिदासन्ति अस्मान् ।
ब्रह्मर्त्वा ते पराञ्चो व्यथन्तां प्रत्यगेनान् प्रतिसरेण हन्मि ॥
verses.rom:
ye dishamantardeshebhyo juhvati jatavedah sarvabhyo digbhyo'bhidasanti asman |
brahmartva te parancho vyathantam pratyagenan pratisarena hanmi ||

prose.en:
1. They who make offering from in front, O Jātavedas, [who] from the eastern quarter vex us—having come upon (ṛ) Agni, let them stagger (vyath) away; I smite them back with the reverter (pratisará).

2. They who make offering from the right, O Jātavedas, [who] from the southern quarter vex us—having come upon Yama, let them etc. etc.

3. They who make offering from behind, O Jātavedas, [who] from the western quarter vex us—having come upon Varuṇa, let them etc. etc.

5. They who make offering from above, O Jātavedas, [who] from the northern quarter vex us—having come upon Soma, let them etc. etc.

6. They who make offering from the atmosphere, O Jātavedas, [who] from the midway (vyadhvá) quarter vex us—having come upon Vāyu, let them etc. etc.

7. They who make offering from aloft, O Jātavedas, [who] from the upward quarter vex us—having come upon Sūrya, let them etc. etc.

8. They who make offering from the intermediate directions of the quarters, O Jātavedas, [who] from all the quarters vex us—having come upon the bráhman, let them etc. etc.
